name.ar: منحة التميز للبكالوريوس بمناسبة الذكرى 75 لجامعة ساوثهامبتون

duration.en: £3,000 a year for up to 4 years
duration.ar: 3,000 جنيه سنوياً لمدة تصل إلى 4 سنوات

deadline_note: Automatic award with no separate deadline: you only need to apply for your course before its deadline (UCAS equal-consideration date 13 Jan 2027; final international date 30 Jun 2027). Page checked 31 Oct 2026.

summary.en: The University of Southampton automatically takes £3,000 a year (up to £12,000 in total) off tuition for new self-funded international undergraduates from selected countries. No separate application is needed.
summary.ka: საუთჰემპტონის უნივერსიტეტი შერჩეული ქვეყნებიდან ახალ, თვითდაფინანსებულ საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებს სწავლის საფასურს წელიწადში £3,000-ით (ჯამში £12,000-მდე) ავტომატურად უმცირებს. ცალკე განაცხადი საჭირო არ არის.
summary.ar: تخصم جامعة ساوثهامبتون تلقائياً 3,000 جنيه سنوياً (حتى 12,000 جنيه إجمالاً) من الرسوم الدراسية لطلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين الجدد ذاتيي التمويل من دول مختارة، دون الحاجة إلى طلب منفصل.

about.en:
The 75th Anniversary Undergraduate Excellence Scholarship celebrates 75 years since Southampton received its Royal Charter. It gives new international undergraduates a tuition fee reduction of £3,000 per year for up to four years (up to £12,000) on any full-time, on-campus bachelor's programme except Medicine.

It is restricted to permanent residents (3+ years) of Bangladesh, China, Hong Kong SAR, India, Malaysia, Nigeria, Pakistan, Taiwan, Thailand, UAE, USA or Vietnam who pay overseas fees themselves. Students from other countries (including Georgia and Qatar) should check Southampton's scholarship finder for other awards. If you qualify for several Southampton scholarships you receive the highest one.

en: Up to £12,000 off tuition over 4 years
Automatic: no scholarship form
Any subject except Medicine

eligibility.en: New international (overseas-fee) undergraduates who are permanent residents of Bangladesh, China, Hong Kong, India, Malaysia, Nigeria, Pakistan, Taiwan, Thailand, UAE, USA or Vietnam, self-funded, holding an offer for a full-time on-campus degree (not Medicine). Citizens/residents of Georgia and Qatar are not on the eligible list.

en: Apply for your degree through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; international applicants can often apply until 30 June 2027).
Receive a conditional or unconditional offer.
The scholarship is applied automatically and confirmed by email.

costs.en: £3,000 tuition fee reduction per year for up to 4 years (max £12,000). Does not cover living costs.

score_reason: Automatic £12k award at a Russell Group university, but limited to 12 countries.

name.ar: منحة نائب رئيس جامعة نيوكاسل الدولية (البكالوريوس)

duration.en: £7,000 a year for the whole degree

deadline_note: You must apply to the course via UCAS by 13 Jan 2027 and, if offered by 31 Mar 2027, firm/insure Newcastle by 3 May 2027. Confirmed for 2027/28 on the official page.

summary.en: Newcastle University gives international undergraduates from listed countries and all EU states £7,000 off tuition every year of their degree. You are assessed automatically with your course application.
summary.ka: ნიუკასლის უნივერსიტეტი ჩამოთვლილი ქვეყნებისა და ყველა EU-ს ქვეყნის საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებს სწავლის საფასურს ყოველწლიურად £7,000-ით უმცირებს. შეფასება კურსზე განაცხადთან ერთად ავტომატურად ხდება.
summary.ar: تمنح جامعة نيوكاسل طلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين من الدول المدرجة وجميع دول الاتحاد الأوروبي خصماً قدره 7,000 جنيه من الرسوم كل عام طوال الدراسة، ويتم التقييم تلقائياً مع طلب الالتحاق.

about.en:
Newcastle University (Russell Group) offers partial Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarships worth £7,000 per year for the full duration of an undergraduate degree starting in September 2027 at the Newcastle city-centre campus.

Applicants must be domiciled in one of the listed countries/regions (including Algeria, Bahrain, Bangladesh, Brazil, Canada, Egypt, India, Indonesia, Japan, Jordan, Kenya, Malaysia, Mexico, Nigeria, Norway, Pakistan, Singapore, South Africa, Switzerland, Türkiye, UAE, Ukraine, USA, Vietnam, all EU member states and others). Georgia and Qatar are not on the published list. Candidates are judged on their academic application; a list of excluded courses is in the 2027-28 terms PDF.

en: £7,000 every year of the degree
No separate form: assessed with your UCAS application
Open to all EU states and ~35 other countries

eligibility.en: International-fee applicants domiciled in an eligible country/region (see page; Georgia and Qatar not listed) with an offer for an eligible 2027/28 undergraduate course at the Newcastle campus. Türkiye-domiciled applicants must be self-funded.

en: Apply via UCAS by the equal-consideration deadline of 13 January 2027.
If you receive an offer by 31 March 2027, accept Newcastle as Firm or Insurance choice by 3 May 2027.
Eligible candidates are assessed automatically; awards are made through the year.

costs.en: £7,000 tuition fee reduction each year of the degree. Living costs not covered.

score_reason: Multi-year £7k award with an early, clear 2027 deadline; country-restricted.

name.ar: منحة التميز من نائب رئيس جامعة نيوكاسل (البكالوريوس)

deadline_note: Scholarship application closes 2 April 2027; course application via UCAS by 13 Jan 2027. Confirmed on the official 2027 page.

summary.en: Newcastle's most generous undergraduate award for international students covers up to half of tuition for the full degree. Any nationality paying international fees can apply once they hold an offer.
summary.ka: ნიუკასლის ყველაზე გულუხვი საბაკალავრო სტიპენდია საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის სწავლის საფასურის ნახევრამდე ფარავს მთელი პროგრამის განმავლობაში. შეთავაზების მიღების შემდეგ ნებისმიერი ქვეყნის მოქალაქეს შეუძლია განაცხადის შეტანა.
summary.ar: أسخى منحة بكالوريوس تقدمها جامعة نيوكاسل للطلاب الدوليين، وتغطي حتى نصف الرسوم الدراسية طوال مدة الدرجة. يمكن لأي طالب يدفع الرسوم الدولية التقدّم بعد حصوله على عرض قبول.

about.en:
The Vice-Chancellor's Excellence Scholarships reward outstanding international undergraduates with up to 50% off tuition fees for the full length of their degree, starting September 2027 at Newcastle's city-centre campus.

There is no country restriction: any applicant assessed as international for fees can apply, including students from Georgia and Qatar. You need (or expect) at least ABB at A level or equivalent, an offer for an eligible programme, and a separate scholarship application in the Apply to Newcastle Portal. Selection weighs academic ability, commitment to study and the quality of the application.

en: Up to 50% off tuition for the whole degree
Open to every nationality paying international fees
Separate application by 2 April 2027

eligibility.en: International-fee applicants of any nationality with an offer for an eligible 2027/28 undergraduate programme and at least ABB at A level (or equivalent). Must apply via UCAS by 13 Jan 2027 and firm/insure Newcastle by 3 May 2027 if offered by 31 Mar.

en: Apply to your course via UCAS by 13 January 2027.
After receiving your offer, log in to the Apply to Newcastle Portal.
Complete the form under 'scholarship applications' before 2 April 2027.
Accept Newcastle as Firm or Insurance choice by 3 May 2027.

costs.en: Up to 50% tuition fee reduction every year of the degree.

score_reason: Half-tuition for the whole degree, open to all nationalities, deadline April 2027.

name.ar: منحة التميز الدولية للبكالوريوس في جامعة ليدز

deadline_note: Final scholarship deadline 11 April 2027; outcomes by 10 May 2027. Form opens for offer holders (link emailed). Confirmed on the official 2027 page.

summary.en: The University of Leeds offers international first-year undergraduates a £3,000, £6,000 or £16,000 discount on first-year tuition. Offer holders apply with a short statement about their goals and activities.
summary.ka: ლიდსის უნივერსიტეტი საერთაშორისო პირველკურსელ ბაკალავრებს პირველი წლის საფასურზე £3,000, £6,000 ან £16,000 ფასდაკლებას სთავაზობს. შეთავაზების მქონეები მოკლე წერილით აპლიკირებენ.
summary.ar: تقدم جامعة ليدز لطلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين في السنة الأولى خصماً قدره 3,000 أو 6,000 أو 16,000 جنيه على رسوم السنة الأولى، ويتقدم حاملو عروض القبول بنص قصير عن أهدافهم وأنشطتهم.

about.en:
Leeds (Russell Group) awards a substantial number of Undergraduate International Excellence Scholarships to self-funded international students starting a degree in September 2027. Awards of £3,000, £6,000 or £16,000 are taken off first-year tuition.

Any nationality can apply, including Georgia and Qatar, as long as you are classed as international for fees and hold an offer. Selection is based on excellent school results, extracurricular achievements and a statement explaining why Leeds fits your ambitions. Medicine (MBChB) and Dentistry (BChD) are excluded.

en: £3,000, £6,000 or £16,000 off first-year fees
Open to every nationality
Deadline 11 April 2027

eligibility.en: Self-funded or partially funded international-fee students entering Year 1 of an eligible undergraduate course in Sept 2027, with an offer and strong grades and extracurriculars. Not Medicine or Dentistry.

en: Apply for your course through UCAS.
Wait for a conditional or unconditional offer.
Leeds emails offer holders a link to the scholarship form; submit one form per course.
Explain why you chose Leeds and how it fits your goals; submit by 11 April 2027.

costs.en: One-off tuition discount of £3,000, £6,000 or £16,000 in the first year.

score_reason: Open to all nationalities, up to £16k; one-year only.

name.ar: المنحة الإقليمية الدولية للبكالوريوس في جامعة ليدز

deadline_note: Automatic and ongoing: awarded to eligible passport holders with an offer for Sept 2027 (including Clearing). Confirmed on the official page.

summary.en: Leeds automatically takes £5,000 off first-year tuition for international undergraduates holding a passport from eligible countries, including all EU states and Türkiye. No application is required.
summary.ka: ლიდსი ავტომატურად აკლებს £5,000-ს პირველი წლის საფასურს იმ საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებს, რომლებსაც აქვთ შესაბამისი ქვეყნის, მათ შორის EU-ს ყველა ქვეყნისა და თურქეთის, პასპორტი. განაცხადი საჭირო არ არის.
summary.ar: تخصم جامعة ليدز تلقائياً 5,000 جنيه من رسوم السنة الأولى لطلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين الحاملين لجوازات دول مؤهلة، منها جميع دول الاتحاد الأوروبي وتركيا، دون الحاجة إلى طلب.

about.en:
The Undergraduate International Regional Scholarship is an automatic £5,000 reduction on first-year tuition for international-fee students starting a Leeds undergraduate degree in September 2027, designed to ease the cost of moving to the UK.

It depends on your passport, not where you live: eligible passports are Canada, Egypt, all EU member states, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Jordan, Kenya, Nigeria, Norway, Singapore, Switzerland, Türkiye and the USA. Georgian and Qatari passports are not on the list. You must be self-funded or partially funded and entering Year 1.

en: Automatic £5,000 off first-year fees
Covers all EU passports plus 13 other countries
Also applies to Clearing offers

eligibility.en: Holders of an eligible passport (Canada, Egypt, EU, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Jordan, Kenya, Nigeria, Norway, Singapore, Switzerland, Türkiye, USA) paying international fees, self/partially funded, with an offer for Year 1 in Sept 2027. Not Georgia or Qatar.

en: Apply for your Leeds course via UCAS.
Hold a conditional or unconditional offer (Clearing offers count).
The £5,000 reduction is applied automatically to your first-year fee.

costs.en: £5,000 off the first year's tuition fee.

score_reason: Automatic but modest and passport-restricted.

name.ar: منحة التميز لطلاب البكالوريوس في جامعة ليفربول

deadline_note: Automatic award; the page currently shows 2026 entry and says 2027 details will be published soon. Annual scheme.

summary.en: The University of Liverpool gives new international undergraduates who achieve AAA at A level (or equivalent) a £7,500 tuition discount. It is applied automatically with no application.
summary.ka: ლივერპულის უნივერსიტეტი ახალ საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებს, რომლებიც A level-ზე AAA-ს (ან ეკვივალენტს) მიიღებენ, სწავლის საფასურზე £7,500-ის ფასდაკლებას ავტომატურად აძლევს.
summary.ar: تمنح جامعة ليفربول طلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين الجدد الحاصلين على AAA في A level (أو ما يعادلها) خصماً قدره 7,500 جنيه على الرسوم تلقائياً ودون طلب.

about.en:
The Liverpool Excellence Scholarship for Undergraduates is a £7,500 tuition fee discount for high-achieving international students starting a new undergraduate degree at the Liverpool campus (Russell Group). It is awarded automatically to every eligible student.

There is no nationality restriction: students from Georgia, Qatar or anywhere else who pay international fees and achieve AAA at A level or an equivalent qualification qualify. Clinical Medicine and Dental Surgery, online study and sponsored students are excluded, and it cannot be combined with other Liverpool scholarships. Liverpool is reviewing awards for 2027 entry, so check the page for final 2027 terms.

en: £7,500 tuition discount
Automatic for AAA (or equivalent) achievers
All nationalities

eligibility.en: New international-fee undergraduates at the Liverpool campus achieving AAA at A level or equivalent (country equivalents listed). Excludes Medicine, Dental Surgery, online study and sponsored students.

en: Apply for your undergraduate course via UCAS.
Meet the AAA (or equivalent) grade requirement.
The discount is applied automatically to your fees.

costs.en: £7,500 tuition fee discount (no cash value).

score_reason: Automatic and open to all nationalities; 2027 terms pending.

name.en: Queen's University Belfast International Undergraduate Scholarship
name.ka: ბელფასტის ქუინზის უნივერსიტეტის საერთაშორისო საბაკალავრო სტიპენდია
name.ar: منحة البكالوريوس الدولية في جامعة كوينز بلفاست

deadline_note: Automatic on enrolment; page shows the 2026/27 scheme, which runs every year. Separate £1,500 Early Confirmation Award if fees are paid by the deadline.

summary.en: Queen's University Belfast automatically gives new international undergraduates from every region £3,500 or £4,000 off tuition. Paying fees early can add a further £1,500 discount.
summary.ka: ბელფასტის ქუინზის უნივერსიტეტი ყველა რეგიონის ახალ საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებს სწავლის საფასურს ავტომატურად £3,500-ით ან £4,000-ით უმცირებს. საფასურის ადრე გადახდა დამატებით £1,500-ის ფასდაკლებას იძლევა.
summary.ar: تمنح جامعة كوينز بلفاست طلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين الجدد من جميع المناطق خصماً تلقائياً قدره 3,500 أو 4,000 جنيه، ويمكن الحصول على خصم إضافي قدره 1,500 جنيه عند الدفع المبكر.

about.en:
Queen's University Belfast (Russell Group, Northern Ireland) awards an International Undergraduate Scholarship worth £3,500 or £4,000 (depending on the fee band) to new full-time international undergraduates, including those entering Year 2 or 3. It is applied automatically on enrolment.

It is open to students from Europe and Central Asia (including Georgia), the Middle East (including Qatar), Asia, Africa and the Americas; Irish students are excluded. New students with an unconditional offer who pay their first-year fees in full by the published deadline also get a £1,500 Early Confirmation Award.

en: £3,500–£4,000 off tuition automatically
Explicitly covers Georgia and Qatar regions
Extra £1,500 for early fee payment

eligibility.en: New full-time international-fee undergraduates from any region outside Ireland (Georgia and Qatar included). Exclusions for some programmes apply.

en: Apply to Queen's through UCAS.
Accept your offer and enrol.
The scholarship is applied automatically; for the Early Confirmation Award, pay fees in full and email proof by the deadline.

costs.en: £3,500 or £4,000 tuition reduction plus optional £1,500 early-payment discount.

score_reason: Automatic award that explicitly includes Georgia and Qatar; modest value.

org: Tempus Public Foundation / Government of Hungary

name.ar: منحة ستيبنديوم هنغاريكوم — البكالوريوس (2027/28)

duration.en: Full length of the bachelor's degree

deadline_note: Estimated: the 2026/27 call closed 15 Jan 2026 (2 pm CET) after opening in autumn 2025; the 2027/28 call is expected on the same pattern. Sending partners (e.g. your ministry or Hungarian embassy) may set earlier internal deadlines.

summary.en: Hungary's flagship government scholarship pays full tuition, a monthly stipend, housing support and health insurance for international bachelor's students at Hungarian universities. You apply through your country's sending partner and the online SH portal.
summary.ka: უნგრეთის მთავრობის მთავარი სტიპენდია უნგრეთის უნივერსიტეტებში საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებს უფარავს სწავლის საფასურს, ყოველთვიურ სტიპენდიას, საცხოვრებლის დახმარებასა და სამედიცინო დაზღვევას. განაცხადი ქვეყნის გამგზავნი პარტნიორისა და SH-ის ონლაინ პორტალის მეშვეობით შეგაქვთ.
summary.ar: منحة الحكومة المجرية الرئيسية تغطي الرسوم الدراسية كاملة وراتباً شهرياً ودعماً للسكن وتأميناً صحياً لطلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين في الجامعات المجرية. يتم التقديم عبر الجهة المرشِّحة في بلدك وبوابة المنحة الإلكترونية.

about.en:
Stipendium Hungaricum (SH) is the Hungarian government's scholarship for citizens of around 90 partner countries. It funds full bachelor's degrees (as well as master's and PhD) at dozens of Hungarian universities, with hundreds of programmes taught in English or Hungarian.

Applicants register on the online portal, choose up to two programmes and must also be nominated by their country's sending partner (a ministry, council or the Hungarian embassy). Georgia is an SH partner country; check the annex list for your country's quota and allowed study levels. Universities then run their own entrance exams or interviews.

en: Full tuition plus monthly stipend
Housing in a dorm or monthly contribution, plus health insurance
Hundreds of English-taught bachelor's programmes

eligibility.en: Citizens of Stipendium Hungaricum sending-partner countries (Georgia included; see the annual list) who have or will obtain a secondary-school leaving certificate by enrolment. Hungarian citizens are not eligible. Each partner country sets quotas, levels and fields.

en: Check that your country is a sending partner and which levels it supports.
Choose up to two eligible programmes on the SH study finder.
Register on the SH application portal and upload documents (diploma/transcripts, language certificate, motivation letter, medical certificate, etc.).
Submit to your sending partner by its own deadline as well.
Sit the university's entrance exam/interview; results usually come in spring/summer.

costs.en: Tuition-free study, monthly stipend (HUF 43,700 at bachelor level in recent calls), dormitory place or HUF 40,000/month housing contribution, and medical insurance.

score_reason: Fully funded government scheme open to Georgian citizens; deadline mid-January.

org: Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities (YTB)

name.ar: منح تركيا (Türkiye Bursları) — البكالوريوس 2027

duration.en: Full length of the bachelor's degree

deadline_note: Estimated from the 2026 cycle (10 Jan – 20 Feb 2026, one period for all countries). The 2027 dates will be announced on the official site; the pattern has been stable for several years.

summary.en: Türkiye's government scholarship places international students at Turkish universities and covers tuition, a monthly stipend, housing, health insurance, flights and a year of Turkish. Applications are free and online.
summary.ka: თურქეთის სამთავრობო სტიპენდია საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს თურქეთის უნივერსიტეტებში ანაწილებს და ფარავს სწავლის საფასურს, ყოველთვიურ სტიპენდიას, საცხოვრებელს, დაზღვევას, ავიაბილეთებსა და თურქული ენის ერთწლიან კურსს. განაცხადი უფასოა და ონლაინ.
summary.ar: منحة الحكومة التركية تُلحق الطلاب الدوليين بالجامعات التركية وتغطي الرسوم وراتباً شهرياً والسكن والتأمين الصحي وتذاكر الطيران وسنة لتعلم التركية، والتقديم مجاني عبر الإنترنت.

about.en:
Türkiye Scholarships (Türkiye Bursları), run by the government agency YTB, is a competitive, merit-based programme for citizens of all countries. It funds associate, bachelor's, master's and PhD study and also handles university placement, so you are admitted to a Turkish university as part of the award.

Bachelor's applicants must be under 21 and meet minimum grade averages (90% for Medicine, Dentistry and Pharmacy). Selection is by online application and interview. Students from Georgia, Qatar and every other country can apply; Turkish citizens and those who have lost Turkish citizenship cannot.

en: Full scholarship with university placement
Monthly stipend, dorm, insurance and flights
Open to citizens of every country

eligibility.en: Citizens of all countries (not Turkish citizens or former Turkish citizens), under 21 for bachelor's, graduating from secondary school by August of the application year, meeting the minimum grade average (90% for Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy). Not for students already enrolled at the same level in Türkiye.

en: Watch the official site for the 2027 call (expected 10 January).
Create an account on the online application system (free).
Choose up to 12 university programmes and upload transcripts, ID, photo, test scores and a statement.
Shortlisted candidates are interviewed (in person or online).
Results are announced in summer; scholars start with a one-year Turkish course.

costs.en: Full tuition, monthly stipend, accommodation, health insurance, one-time round-trip flight and a one-year Turkish language course.

score_reason: Fully funded, open to every nationality, predictable Jan–Feb window.

org: Nuffic / Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science

name.ar: منحة NL (منحة هولندا سابقاً) — البكالوريوس

deadline_note: Each participating institution sets its own closing date (historically 1 February or 1 May for September entry). Check the university's page; the 2027-28 participant list is published by Nuffic.

summary.en: The NL Scholarship gives non-EEA students €5,000 in their first year of a bachelor's or master's at participating Dutch universities. You apply through the university you are admitted to.
summary.ka: NL Scholarship ევროპის ეკონომიკური ზონის გარეთა სტუდენტებს მონაწილე ჰოლანდიურ უნივერსიტეტებში ბაკალავრიატის ან მაგისტრატურის პირველ წელს €5,000-ს აძლევს. განაცხადი იმ უნივერსიტეტის მეშვეობით შეგაქვთ, სადაც ჩაირიცხებით.
summary.ar: تمنح منحة NL الطلاب من خارج المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية 5,000 يورو في السنة الأولى من البكالوريوس أو الماجستير في الجامعات الهولندية المشاركة، ويتم التقديم عبر الجامعة التي تُقبل فيها.

about.en:
The NL Scholarship (until recently called the Holland Scholarship) is funded by the Dutch Ministry of Education together with Dutch research universities and universities of applied sciences. It is a one-off €5,000 grant in the first year of study, not a full-tuition award.

It is for non-EEA nationals (so students from Georgia, Qatar and most of the world qualify) applying for a full-time bachelor's or master's at a participating institution, who have no previous Dutch degree. Participants in 2026-27 included Maastricht, Groningen, Radboud, Twente, Utrecht, VU Amsterdam, TU/e, Wageningen and many universities of applied sciences. Each institution sets its own deadline and eligible programmes.

en: €5,000 in your first year
For all non-EEA nationalities
Dozens of participating Dutch universities

eligibility.en: Non-EEA nationals applying for a full-time bachelor's or master's at a participating Dutch institution, meeting its specific requirements, with no previous degree from a Dutch institution.

en: Check the participating institutions list on Study in NL.
Apply for your bachelor's programme (usually via Studielink and the university).
Find the NL Scholarship page of that institution and submit its scholarship application by its deadline (often 1 February or 1 May).
Receive the €5,000 in your first year if selected.

costs.en: €5,000 one-off in the first year; tuition for non-EEA bachelor's students is usually €9,000–€20,000+ a year.

score_reason: Widely available €5k grant for all non-EEA students at many Dutch universities.

name.ar: منحة التفوق الأكاديمي في جامعة كونستركتور (البكالوريوس)

duration.en: Each year of a 3–4 year bachelor's degree
duration.ar: كل سنة من درجة بكالوريوس مدتها 3–4 سنوات

deadline_note: Early Action applications 1 Oct 2026 – 1 Feb 2027; rolling admission continues to 31 Jul 2027. Scholarship is assessed automatically at admission. Confirmed for 2027/28.

summary.en: Constructor University, an English-language private university in Bremen, automatically considers every bachelor's applicant for a GPA-based scholarship of up to €10,000, plus an optional tuition deferral. No separate application is needed.
summary.ka: Constructor University, ინგლისურენოვანი კერძო უნივერსიტეტი ბრემენში, ბაკალავრიატის ყველა აპლიკანტს ავტომატურად განიხილავს GPA-ზე დაფუძნებული €10,000-მდე სტიპენდიისთვის, დამატებით კი სწავლის საფასურის გადავადებაც შესაძლებელია.
summary.ar: تنظر جامعة كونستركتور، وهي جامعة خاصة ناطقة بالإنجليزية في بريمن، تلقائياً في منح كل متقدم للبكالوريوس منحة تصل إلى 10,000 يورو بناءً على المعدل، مع إمكانية تأجيل جزء من الرسوم.

about.en:
Constructor University (formerly Jacobs University) is an international, English-taught residential university in Bremen, Germany, with students from over 100 countries. Bachelor's tuition for 2027/28 is €11,925 per semester.

All admitted students are considered for an academic achievement scholarship of up to €10,000 based on school GPA, announced with the admission decision; there is no extra form and no nationality restriction. A Tuition Deferral Program lets you postpone part of the remaining fees until you are employed after graduation.

en: Up to €10,000 merit scholarship
Automatic with admission
Tuition deferral: repay only once you are earning

eligibility.en: All bachelor's applicants admitted to Constructor University, any nationality (Georgia and Qatar included). Amount depends on school GPA.

en: Apply online for a bachelor's programme (Early Action until 1 Feb 2027).
Submit transcripts, English test or waiver evidence.
Your scholarship amount is shown with your admission decision.
Optionally accept the Tuition Deferral offer for part of the remaining fees.

costs.en: Scholarship up to €10,000; 2027/28 tuition €11,925 per semester plus fees up to €350 and a one-time enrolment fee (€940 non-EU).

score_reason: Automatic merit aid at an English-taught German university, any nationality.

name.en: AUBG Merit Scholarships and Financial Aid — Bachelor's (Fall 2027)
name.ka: AUBG-ის აკადემიური სტიპენდიები და ფინანსური დახმარება — ბაკალავრიატი (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: منح الجدارة والمساعدات المالية في الجامعة الأمريكية في بلغاريا — البكالوريوس (خريف 2027)

duration.en: Full length of the bachelor's degree

deadline_note: Fall 2027 deadlines on the official page: Priority admission and donor-funded merit scholarships 15 Jan 2027; need-based scholarships 31 Jan 2027; Early 15 Mar; Regular 15 May (less aid later).

summary.en: The American University in Bulgaria offers donor-funded merit scholarships and need-based financial aid to bachelor's students from around the world; 81% of last year's new students received support. Apply by 15 January for the best chance.
summary.ka: ბულგარეთის ამერიკული უნივერსიტეტი მსოფლიოს სხვადასხვა ქვეყნის ბაკალავრებს დონორების მიერ დაფინანსებულ აკადემიურ სტიპენდიებსა და საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებულ დახმარებას სთავაზობს; გასულ წელს ახალი სტუდენტების 81%-მა მიიღო მხარდაჭერა.
summary.ar: تقدم الجامعة الأمريكية في بلغاريا منح جدارة ممولة من المانحين ومساعدات مالية حسب الحاجة لطلاب البكالوريوس من حول العالم، وقد حصل 81% من الطلاب الجدد العام الماضي على دعم. قدّم قبل 15 يناير لأفضل فرصة.

about.en:
AUBG is an American-style liberal arts university in Blagoevgrad, Bulgaria, accredited in the US and EU, with English-taught majors in business, economics, computer science, journalism, political science and more. It attracts many students from the Balkans, the Black Sea region, Central Asia and beyond.

Priority applicants (15 January) get the earliest decision and best chance of funding: donor-funded merit-based scholarships (apply by 15 Jan) and donor-funded need-based scholarships (apply by 31 Jan). Students from any country, including Georgia, can apply; awards are combined with AUBG's institutional aid.

en: 81% of new students got aid last year
Merit + need-based packages
US-accredited liberal arts degree in Europe

eligibility.en: International and Bulgarian applicants to bachelor's programmes for Fall 2027. Need-based aid requires financial documents; merit awards are based on academic record and achievements.

en: Apply for admission by the Priority deadline (15 January 2027).
Submit the donor-funded merit scholarship application by 15 January 2027.
Submit the need-based scholarship application with financial documents by 31 January 2027.
Receive your admission and aid package with the earliest decisions.

costs.en: Scholarships and aid reduce tuition by varying amounts; loans and other support also available.

score_reason: Generous aid at a US-accredited university, clear 15 Jan deadline.

name.en: University of Limerick International (Non-EU) Merit Scholarships — Undergraduate
name.ka: ლიმერიკის უნივერსიტეტის საერთაშორისო (არა-EU) აკადემიური სტიპენდიები — ბაკალავრიატი
name.ar: منح الجدارة الدولية (لغير الاتحاد الأوروبي) في جامعة ليمريك — البكالوريوس

duration.en: Each year of a 3–4 year bachelor's degree
duration.ar: كل سنة من درجة بكالوريوس مدتها 3–4 سنوات

deadline_note: Automatic: you are reviewed when you apply for a programme and hear with your offer. Page lists 2026/7 amounts; scheme runs annually.

summary.en: The University of Limerick automatically reviews every non-EU undergraduate applicant for a merit scholarship of €2,000–€2,500 off tuition each year. The decision arrives together with your offer.
summary.ka: ლიმერიკის უნივერსიტეტი ყველა არა-EU საბაკალავრო აპლიკანტს ავტომატურად განიხილავს აკადემიური სტიპენდიისთვის, რომელიც ყოველწლიურად სწავლის საფასურს €2,000–€2,500-ით ამცირებს. გადაწყვეტილება შეთავაზებასთან ერთად მოდის.
summary.ar: تراجع جامعة ليمريك تلقائياً كل متقدم للبكالوريوس من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي لمنحة جدارة تخفض الرسوم بمقدار 2,000–2,500 يورو سنوياً، ويصل القرار مع عرض القبول.

about.en:
UL in Limerick, Ireland, offers partial merit-based scholarships for international (non-EU) undergraduates in each faculty: €2,000 per year in Science and Engineering and in Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences, and €2,500 per year at the Kemmy Business School. They are tuition fee reductions.

There is no separate application: once you apply for a programme you are automatically reviewed and told at the same time as your offer. Any non-EU nationality qualifies, including Georgia and Qatar. Extra awards exist for Indian students.

en: €2,000–€2,500 off tuition every year
Automatic review with your application
All non-EU nationalities

eligibility.en: Non-EU (international fee-paying) applicants to UL undergraduate programmes, judged on academic merit.

en: Apply for your UL undergraduate programme (international direct application).
You are automatically considered for a faculty scholarship.
The scholarship decision is sent with your offer.

costs.en: Tuition reduction of €2,000 per year (Science & Engineering; Arts, Humanities & Social Sciences) or €2,500 per year (Kemmy Business School).

score_reason: Automatic multi-year award, all non-EU nationalities, modest value.

name.en: Lancaster University Undergraduate International Excellence Scholarship
name.ka: ლანკასტერის უნივერსიტეტის საბაკალავრო საერთაშორისო ექსელენსის სტიპენდია
name.ar: منحة التميز الدولية للبكالوريوس في جامعة لانكستر

duration.en: Each year of a 3–4 year bachelor's degree
duration.ar: كل سنة من درجة بكالوريوس مدتها 3–4 سنوات

deadline_note: Automatic for 2027 entry; you must make Lancaster your firm UCAS choice (firm-choice dates depend on when you receive offers; UCAS final international date ~30 Jun 2027).

summary.en: Lancaster takes £3,000 off tuition every year for international undergraduates who achieve A*AA (or equivalent) and make Lancaster their firm choice. It is awarded automatically.
summary.ka: ლანკასტერი საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებს, რომლებიც A*AA-ს (ან ეკვივალენტს) მიიღებენ და ლანკასტერს მთავარ არჩევანად დაასახელებენ, ყოველწლიურად £3,000-ით უმცირებს საფასურს. სტიპენდია ავტომატურად ენიჭებათ.
summary.ar: تخصم جامعة لانكستر 3,000 جنيه سنوياً من رسوم طلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين الحاصلين على A*AA (أو ما يعادلها) والذين يختارونها خياراً أول، ويُمنح ذلك تلقائياً.

about.en:
Lancaster University, a top-15 UK university, rewards high-achieving international undergraduates starting in 2027 with a £3,000 tuition fee reduction for each year of study.

You qualify if you achieve A*AA at A level (or the equivalent in IB or another qualification), place Lancaster as your firm UCAS choice and pay international fees. Every nationality is eligible, including Georgia and Qatar. Eligible students are identified automatically; there is no form.

en: £3,000 off every year of study
Automatic for A*AA or equivalent
Open to all nationalities

eligibility.en: International fee-paying applicants for 2027 entry who achieve A*AA at A level (or equivalent) and make Lancaster their firm UCAS choice.

en: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Accept Lancaster as your firm choice.
Meet A*AA (or equivalent); the fee reduction is applied automatically.

costs.en: £3,000 tuition fee reduction per year of study.

score_reason: Automatic multi-year award for strong students of any nationality.

name.en: Lancaster University Undergraduate International Regional Scholarship
name.ka: ლანკასტერის უნივერსიტეტის საბაკალავრო საერთაშორისო რეგიონული სტიპენდია
name.ar: المنحة الإقليمية الدولية للبكالوريوس في جامعة لانكستر

duration.en: Each year of a 3–4 year bachelor's degree
duration.ar: كل سنة من درجة بكالوريوس مدتها 3–4 سنوات

deadline_note: Automatic for 2027 entry; apply via UCAS before course deadlines (final international date ~30 Jun 2027).

summary.en: Lancaster gives £3,000 off tuition every year to international undergraduates from 12 countries including Türkiye, Egypt, Indonesia, Pakistan and Nigeria. It is awarded automatically on application.
summary.ka: ლანკასტერი 12 ქვეყნის, მათ შორის თურქეთის, ეგვიპტის, ინდონეზიის, პაკისტანისა და ნიგერიის, საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებს ყოველწლიურად £3,000-ით უმცირებს საფასურს. სტიპენდია ავტომატურად ენიჭებათ.
summary.ar: تخصم جامعة لانكستر 3,000 جنيه سنوياً من رسوم طلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين من 12 دولة منها تركيا ومصر وإندونيسيا وباكستان ونيجيريا، ويُمنح ذلك تلقائياً.

about.en:
The International Regional Scholarship is a £3,000 tuition fee reduction for each year of an undergraduate course starting in 2027, aimed at countries that are under-represented at Lancaster.

You must be a national of, or permanently live in, Canada, Egypt, Ghana, Indonesia, Kenya, Malaysia, Nigeria, Pakistan, Taiwan, Thailand, Türkiye or Vietnam, pay international fees and meet entry grades. Georgia and Qatar are not on the list (see the Excellence Scholarship instead).

en: £3,000 off every year
12 eligible countries incl. Türkiye and Egypt
Automatic

eligibility.en: International fee payers who are nationals or permanent residents of Canada, Egypt, Ghana, Indonesia, Kenya, Malaysia, Nigeria, Pakistan, Taiwan, Thailand, Türkiye or Vietnam, starting an undergraduate course in 2027.

en: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Meet the entry requirements of your offer.
The fee reduction is applied automatically.

costs.en: £3,000 tuition fee reduction per year of study.

score_reason: Automatic multi-year award but limited to 12 countries.

name.en: University of Essex International Undergraduate Scholarship
name.ar: منحة البكالوريوس الدولية في جامعة إسكس

deadline_note: Automatic for 2027-28 entry; no form. Apply for your course before the relevant UCAS deadline.

summary.en: Essex automatically gives a £5,000 first-year discount to international undergraduates from a long list of countries, explicitly including Georgia and Qatar. No application form is needed.
summary.ka: ესექსი საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებს ქვეყნების ვრცელი სიიდან, მათ შორის საქართველოდან და კატარიდან, პირველი წლის საფასურზე £5,000-იან ფასდაკლებას ავტომატურად აძლევს. განაცხადის ფორმა საჭირო არ არის.
summary.ar: تمنح جامعة إسكس تلقائياً خصماً قدره 5,000 جنيه في السنة الأولى لطلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين من قائمة طويلة من الدول تشمل جورجيا وقطر صراحةً، دون الحاجة إلى نموذج طلب.

about.en:
The University of Essex (Colchester campus) offers overseas fee payers from specified countries a £5,000 discount on first-year tuition for undergraduate entry in 2027-28, across all departments.

Eligible regions include every African Union member state, most of Asia and the Middle East (Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Oman, Jordan, Kazakhstan and many more) and the Americas. Eligibility is checked automatically from the country of domicile and fee status on your course application.

en: £5,000 off first-year fees
Georgia and Qatar explicitly eligible
No application form

eligibility.en: Overseas fee payers domiciled in a listed country (incl. Georgia and Qatar) starting an Essex undergraduate degree in 2027-28.

en: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Make sure your domicile and fee status are correct on your application.
The discount is applied automatically if you are eligible.

costs.en: £5,000 discount on first-year tuition only.

score_reason: Automatic, explicitly open to Georgia and Qatar; one year only.

name.en: University of Stirling International Undergraduate Scholarship
name.ar: منحة البكالوريوس الدولية في جامعة ستيرلينغ

deadline_note: Automatic for entry in January 2027, September 2027 or January 2028; no separate deadline beyond course application dates.

summary.en: Stirling, in Scotland, automatically reduces annual fees by £2,500 (up to £10,000 over four years) for every international undergraduate with an offer. All nationalities qualify.
summary.ka: შოტლანდიის სტირლინგის უნივერსიტეტი შეთავაზების მქონე ყველა საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრს ყოველწლიურ საფასურს ავტომატურად £2,500-ით (ოთხ წელიწადში £10,000-მდე) უმცირებს. ყველა ქვეყნის მოქალაქე აკმაყოფილებს პირობას.
summary.ar: تخفض جامعة ستيرلينغ في اسكتلندا تلقائياً الرسوم السنوية بمقدار 2,500 جنيه (حتى 10,000 جنيه على أربع سنوات) لكل طالب بكالوريوس دولي لديه عرض قبول، ولجميع الجنسيات.

about.en:
The University of Stirling's International Undergraduate Scholarship takes £2,500 off each year's tuition (£10,000 over a four-year Scottish degree) for international students, including EU students paying international fees.

It is available to all countries, including Georgia and Qatar. You need an offer for an eligible undergraduate course starting January 2027, September 2027 or January 2028 and must study full time. It cannot be combined with other Stirling scholarships, and visa students still pay the tuition deposit.

en: £10,000 over four years
All nationalities, automatic
Three possible start dates

eligibility.en: Full-time international-fee students (incl. EU) with an offer for an eligible Stirling undergraduate course starting Jan 2027, Sep 2027 or Jan 2028.

en: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Receive a conditional or unconditional offer.
Your annual fee is reduced automatically by £2,500.

costs.en: £2,500 off tuition each year (up to £10,000).

score_reason: Automatic £10k over 4 years for every nationality.

name.en: Oamk Early Bird Discount and Finnish-Language Scholarships — Bachelor's
name.ka: Oamk-ის Early Bird ფასდაკლება და ფინური ენის სტიპენდიები — ბაკალავრიატი
name.ar: خصم التسجيل المبكر ومنح اللغة الفنلندية في جامعة أولو للعلوم التطبيقية — البكالوريوس

duration.en: Full length of the bachelor's degree

deadline_note: Estimated: Finland's joint application for English-taught bachelor's programmes usually runs in early-mid January (2027 dates to be confirmed on Studyinfo.fi). Early Bird requires confirming your place within 7 days of the result.

summary.en: Oulu University of Applied Sciences cuts €2,000 from first-year tuition for non-EU bachelor's students who confirm their place quickly, and later pays scholarships of up to €6,000 for learning Finnish.
summary.ka: ოულუს გამოყენებითი მეცნიერებების უნივერსიტეტი არა-EU ბაკალავრებს, რომლებიც ადგილს სწრაფად დაადასტურებენ, პირველი წლის საფასურს €2,000-ით უმცირებს, შემდეგ კი ფინური ენის შესწავლისთვის €6,000-მდე სტიპენდიას იხდის.
summary.ar: تخصم جامعة أولو للعلوم التطبيقية 2,000 يورو من رسوم السنة الأولى لطلاب البكالوريوس من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي الذين يؤكدون مقاعدهم بسرعة، وتدفع لاحقاً منحاً تصل إلى 6,000 يورو لتعلم الفنلندية.

about.en:
Oamk in Oulu, northern Finland, charges non-EU/EEA students about €10,000 a year for English-taught bachelor's programmes. Every newly selected fee-paying student gets a €2,000 Early Bird discount on first-year tuition if they confirm their study place within 7 days of the admission result.

During the degree Oamk also awards scholarships based solely on Finnish-language skills, up to €6,000 over the normal study time. Students from Georgia, Qatar and all non-EU countries can apply.

en: €2,000 off first-year tuition
Up to €6,000 more for learning Finnish
Practical, career-focused degrees

eligibility.en: Non-EU/EEA students selected for an English-taught Oamk bachelor's programme. Early Bird not available to transfer, double/joint-degree or Open UAS-route students.

en: Apply in Finland's joint application for English-taught bachelor's programmes on Studyinfo.fi (usually early-to-mid January; check the 2027 dates).
Accept your study place within 7 days of the result to get the Early Bird discount.
Pay the reduced first-year fee.
Study Finnish to qualify for later language scholarships.

costs.en: Tuition about €10,000/year; €2,000 Early Bird reduction in year 1; Finnish-language scholarships up to €6,000 in total.

score_reason: Small but reliable discount; mainly useful combined with low Finnish living costs.

name.en: Turku UAS Early Bird Discount — Bachelor's
name.ka: Turku UAS-ის Early Bird ფასდაკლება — ბაკალავრიატი
name.ar: خصم التسجيل المبكر في جامعة توركو للعلوم التطبيقية — البكالوريوس

deadline_note: Estimated: joint application for English-taught bachelor's programmes is usually in January (confirm 2027 dates on Studyinfo.fi). Rolling admission applicants also qualify.

summary.en: Turku University of Applied Sciences gives a €1,000 discount on first-year tuition to non-EU bachelor's students who accept their place within 14 days and pay within 30 days.
summary.ka: ტურკუს გამოყენებითი მეცნიერებების უნივერსიტეტი არა-EU ბაკალავრებს, რომლებიც ადგილს 14 დღეში მიიღებენ და 30 დღეში გადაიხდიან, პირველი წლის საფასურზე €1,000-იან ფასდაკლებას აძლევს.
summary.ar: تمنح جامعة توركو للعلوم التطبيقية طلاب البكالوريوس من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي خصماً قدره 1,000 يورو على رسوم السنة الأولى إذا قبلوا مقاعدهم خلال 14 يوماً ودفعوا خلال 30 يوماً.

about.en:
Turku UAS charges €12,000 per year for its English-taught bachelor's programmes. Students admitted through the joint application, separate application or rolling admission receive a €1,000 Early Bird discount on first-year tuition if they accept the offer within 14 days and pay via Flywire within 30 days of the acceptance email.

It is available to all fee-paying nationalities, including Georgia and Qatar. It is not offered for transfer applications or renewed study rights.

en: €1,000 off first-year tuition
Applies to joint, separate and rolling admissions
Simple: accept and pay early

eligibility.en: Non-EU/EEA fee-paying students admitted to a Turku UAS English-taught degree starting January 2026 or later (excludes transfer/renewed study right).

en: Apply in Finland's joint application for English-taught bachelor's programmes on Studyinfo.fi (usually early-to-mid January; check the 2027 dates).
Accept your offer within 14 days of the acceptance email.
Pay the first-year fee through Flywire within 30 days.

costs.en: €12,000/year tuition; €1,000 discount on year 1.

score_reason: Small discount, but easy to get.

name.ar: منحة التميز الدولية في جامعة لافبرا (البكالوريوس)

deadline_note: Automatic for September 2027 entry via UCAS or OnCampus Loughborough; Loughborough must be your firm choice. Use UCAS dates (final international date ~30 Jun 2027).

summary.en: Loughborough automatically considers international undergraduates for £3,000 off tuition each year (up to £9,000), based on their UCAS application. Grades must be met at the first sitting.
summary.ka: ლაფბორო საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებს UCAS-ის განაცხადის საფუძველზე ავტომატურად განიხილავს ყოველწლიურად £3,000-იანი (£9,000-მდე) ფასდაკლებისთვის. ნიშნები პირველივე ცდაზე უნდა იყოს მიღწეული.
summary.ar: تنظر جامعة لافبرا تلقائياً في منح طلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين خصماً قدره 3,000 جنيه سنوياً (حتى 9,000 جنيه) بناءً على طلب UCAS، ويجب تحقيق الدرجات من المحاولة الأولى.

about.en:
Loughborough, a leading UK university for engineering, sport science and design, offers International Excellence Scholarships of £3,000 towards tuition fees for each year of study (up to £9,000 over a standard degree) for September 2027 entry.

All self-funded international fee-paying applicants of any nationality (Georgia and Qatar included) are considered automatically from their UCAS or OnCampus application. You must make Loughborough your firm choice and meet the academic conditions at the first sitting. The award does not apply in placement or study-abroad years.

en: £3,000 every year of study
Automatic consideration from UCAS
Any nationality

eligibility.en: Self-funded international fee-paying applicants for Sept 2027 entry who firm Loughborough and meet the scholarship grade requirements at first sitting.

en: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Make Loughborough your firm choice.
You are notified shortly after your offer if you have been awarded.

costs.en: £3,000 tuition reduction per year (not during placement/study-abroad years).

score_reason: Automatic multi-year award at a top-10 UK university.

name.ka: აღმოსავლეთ ანგლიის უნივერსიტეტის (UEA) საერთაშორისო საბაკალავრო აკადემიური სტიპენდია
name.ar: منحة الجدارة الدولية للبكالوريوس في جامعة إيست أنجليا

duration.en: £5,000–£10,000 a year for the whole degree

deadline_note: Automatic for September 2027 starters; confirmed shortly after your offer. Apply before UCAS course deadlines.

summary.en: UEA in Norwich gives international undergraduates starting in September 2027 a tuition discount of £5,000, £7,000 or £10,000 every year, depending on the subject. It is confirmed automatically after your offer.
summary.ka: ნორიჯის UEA 2027 წლის სექტემბერში დაწყებულ საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებს საგნის მიხედვით ყოველწლიურად £5,000-ის, £7,000-ის ან £10,000-ის ფასდაკლებას აძლევს. სტიპენდია შეთავაზების შემდეგ ავტომატურად დასტურდება.
summary.ar: تمنح جامعة إيست أنجليا في نوريتش طلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين الذين يبدؤون في سبتمبر 2027 خصماً سنوياً قدره 5,000 أو 7,000 أو 10,000 جنيه حسب التخصص، ويُؤكَّد تلقائياً بعد عرض القبول.

about.en:
The University of East Anglia offers its International Undergraduate Merit Scholarship as an annual tuition fee discount for the whole degree: £10,000 per year for lab-based Faculty of Science courses, £7,000 per year in Economics, Law, Psychology and Norwich Business School, and £5,000 per year in all other schools (and for year-2 pathway entrants).

It is open to international fee payers of any nationality, including Georgia and Qatar, and is confirmed automatically shortly after an offer is made. Some programmes (e.g. Medicine) are excluded; see the page.

en: Up to £10,000 off every year
Automatic after your offer
All nationalities

eligibility.en: International fee-paying students starting an eligible UEA undergraduate degree in September 2027 (exclusions listed on the page).

en: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Receive an offer from UEA.
The scholarship is confirmed automatically shortly after your offer.

costs.en: £10,000, £7,000 or £5,000 tuition fee discount per year depending on school.

score_reason: Large automatic multi-year award open to every nationality.

name.ar: منحة أبردين العالمية — البكالوريوس

deadline_note: Automatic for self-funded international students starting in 2026/27 or 2027/28; shown on your CAS. No deadline beyond course application dates.

summary.en: The University of Aberdeen automatically gives every new self-funded international undergraduate £6,000 off tuition for every year of their degree. It is shown on your CAS.
summary.ka: აბერდინის უნივერსიტეტი ყველა ახალ, თვითდაფინანსებულ საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრს სწავლის საფასურს პროგრამის ყოველ წელს £6,000-ით ავტომატურად უმცირებს. ეს თქვენს CAS-ში აისახება.
summary.ar: تمنح جامعة أبردين تلقائياً كل طالب بكالوريوس دولي جديد ذاتي التمويل خصماً قدره 6,000 جنيه من الرسوم عن كل سنة من الدراسة، ويظهر ذلك في وثيقة CAS.

about.en:
Aberdeen, one of Scotland's ancient universities, offers the Aberdeen Global Scholarship of £6,000 per year (deducted from tuition) to all new self-funded, full-time, on-campus international undergraduates starting in 2026/27 or 2027/28. Scottish degrees usually last four years, so this can be worth about £24,000.

There is no nationality restriction (Georgia and Qatar included). Students who are fully sponsored or hold fully funded external scholarships or other Aberdeen awards are not eligible. Only the Aberdeen campus qualifies.

en: £6,000 off every year (≈£24,000 over 4 years)
Automatic, no application
All nationalities

eligibility.en: New self-funded, full-time, on-campus international-fee undergraduates starting in 2027/28 (not fully sponsored).

en: Apply for your undergraduate course via UCAS.
Accept your offer; the scholarship is applied automatically and shown on your CAS.

costs.en: £6,000 tuition fee waiver each year of the programme.

score_reason: Automatic ~£24k over a degree for all nationalities.

name.en: University of Surrey International Excellence Award (Undergraduate)
name.ar: جائزة التميز الدولية في جامعة سري (البكالوريوس)

deadline_note: Applications for September 2027 close 24 August 2027 (awards must be allocated before a CAS is issued, so apply early).

summary.en: Surrey awards selected international bachelor's students a £5,000 fee waiver based on grades, predicted grades and personal statement. Any nationality can apply if Surrey is their firm UCAS choice.
summary.ka: სარი შერჩეულ საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებს ნიშნების, პროგნოზირებული ნიშნებისა და პირადი წერილის საფუძველზე £5,000-იან შეღავათს ანიჭებს. ნებისმიერი ქვეყნის მოქალაქეს შეუძლია განაცხადი, თუ სარი UCAS-ში მისი მთავარი არჩევანია.
summary.ar: تمنح جامعة سري طلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين المختارين إعفاءً قدره 5,000 جنيه بناءً على الدرجات والدرجات المتوقعة والبيان الشخصي، ويمكن لأي جنسية التقدّم إذا كانت سري الخيار الأول في UCAS.

about.en:
The University of Surrey (Guildford) awards the International Excellence Award, a £5,000 tuition fee waiver, to selected self-funded international students starting a bachelor's degree. It is open regardless of nationality or domicile, so students from Georgia and Qatar can apply.

It is application-based: a panel assesses previous results, predicted grades and your personal statement. Surrey must be your firm UCAS choice, and awards are allocated before CAS issue, so applying early matters.

en: £5,000 fee waiver
Any nationality
Application closes 24 Aug 2027

eligibility.en: Self-funded international fee-paying students starting a Surrey bachelor's in 2027 with Surrey as firm UCAS choice, with a valid student ID/UCAS ID and offer.

en: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Make Surrey your firm choice.
Complete the online scholarship application with your student/UCAS ID before your CAS is issued (final close 24 Aug 2027).

costs.en: £5,000 off tuition fees.

score_reason: Open to all, but a modest one-off award.

name.en: University of York International Undergraduate Achievement Scholarship
name.ka: იორკის უნივერსიტეტის საერთაშორისო საბაკალავრო მიღწევების სტიპენდია
name.ar: منحة الإنجاز الدولية للبكالوريوس في جامعة يورك

deadline_note: 2027/28 scheme published; awarding starts shortly. You need an offer by 1 July 2027. Automatic for eligible offer holders.

summary.en: York automatically considers all international (including EU) undergraduate offer holders for a tuition discount of up to £10,000 in their first year. No application is needed.
summary.ka: იორკი ყველა საერთაშორისო (EU-ს ჩათვლით) საბაკალავრო შეთავაზების მფლობელს ავტომატურად განიხილავს პირველი წლის საფასურზე £10,000-მდე ფასდაკლებისთვის. განაცხადი საჭირო არ არის.
summary.ar: تنظر جامعة يورك تلقائياً في منح جميع حاملي عروض البكالوريوس الدوليين (بمن فيهم طلاب الاتحاد الأوروبي) خصماً يصل إلى 10,000 جنيه في السنة الأولى، دون الحاجة إلى طلب.

about.en:
The University of York (Russell Group) celebrates its best international undergraduate applicants with a tuition fee discount of up to £10,000 for the first year of study in 2027/28.

All eligible international (including EU) students holding a conditional or unconditional offer by 1 July 2027 and paying overseas fees are considered automatically, with no nationality restriction. York also runs country-specific awards (e.g. the Global Impact Scholarship for China, India, Malaysia, Nigeria, Thailand, Türkiye and USA).

en: Up to £10,000 off first-year fees
Automatic for all international offer holders
Russell Group university

eligibility.en: International (incl. EU) overseas-fee students with an offer to study at York by 1 July 2027.

en: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Hold a conditional or unconditional offer by 1 July 2027.
You are considered automatically once awarding starts.

costs.en: Up to £10,000 discount on first-year tuition.

score_reason: Up to £10k, automatic, all nationalities; one year only.

name.en: Strathclyde Undergraduate Scholarships for Physics International Students
name.ka: სტრათკლაიდის საბაკალავრო სტიპენდიები ფიზიკის საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის
name.ar: منح البكالوريوس لطلاب الفيزياء الدوليين في جامعة ستراثكلايد

duration.en: £8,000 a year for the whole degree

deadline_note: Official dates for 2027/28: opens 29 Oct 2026, deadline 30 Jul 2027. Automatic on registration.

summary.en: Strathclyde's Department of Physics gives every new international undergraduate £8,000 off tuition each year of the degree, subject to progression. No separate application is needed.
summary.ka: სტრათკლაიდის ფიზიკის დეპარტამენტი ყველა ახალ საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრს პროგრამის ყოველ წელს სწავლის საფასურს £8,000-ით უმცირებს, აკადემიური პროგრესის პირობით. ცალკე განაცხადი საჭირო არ არის.
summary.ar: يمنح قسم الفيزياء في جامعة ستراثكلايد كل طالب بكالوريوس دولي جديد خصماً قدره 8,000 جنيه من الرسوم كل سنة، بشرط التقدم الأكاديمي، دون الحاجة إلى طلب منفصل.

about.en:
The University of Strathclyde in Glasgow offers numerous scholarships of £8,000 per year to new international students joining an undergraduate physics degree (year one or two) in 2027/28. The award continues annually for the whole degree, subject to academic progression.

Every eligible new international fee-paying student who registers on a full-time physics degree receives it; there is no nationality restriction, so Georgian and Qatari students qualify.

en: £8,000 every year
Automatic for all international physics entrants
Glasgow city-centre campus

eligibility.en: New international fee-paying students registering for year 1 or 2 of a full-time undergraduate degree in Physics at Strathclyde in 2027/28.

en: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Accept your offer and register on the physics degree.
The scholarship is applied automatically; keep making academic progress to renew it.

costs.en: £8,000 tuition fee reduction per year of study.

score_reason: Large automatic award for physics students of any nationality.

name.en: École Polytechnique Bachelor of Science — Excellence Scholarship and Need-Based Aid
name.ka: École Polytechnique-ის ბაკალავრიატი — ექსელენსის სტიპენდია და საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული დახმარება
name.ar: بكالوريوس العلوم في المدرسة متعددة التقنيات — منحة التميز والمساعدة حسب الحاجة

deadline_note: 2027 intake: Round 2 runs 21 Oct 2026 – 6 Jan 2027 (11:59 pm CET); Round 3 closes 8 Feb 2027 (2 pm CET). Aid is limited, so apply in an early round.

summary.en: École Polytechnique's English-taught Bachelor of Science offers a €4,800-a-year Excellence Scholarship for students admitted with honours, plus need-based tuition waivers and interest-free loans for international students.
summary.ka: École Polytechnique-ის ინგლისურენოვანი ბაკალავრიატი წარჩინებით მიღებულ სტუდენტებს წელიწადში €4,800-იან ექსელენსის სტიპენდიას, ხოლო საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებულ საფასურის შეღავათსა და უპროცენტო სესხს სთავაზობს.
summary.ar: يقدم بكالوريوس العلوم الناطق بالإنجليزية في المدرسة متعددة التقنيات منحة تميز بقيمة 4,800 يورو سنوياً للمقبولين بامتياز، إضافة إلى إعفاءات من الرسوم وقروض بلا فوائد حسب الحاجة للطلاب الدوليين.

about.en:
École Polytechnique (IP Paris), one of France's top engineering schools, runs a three-year, English-taught Bachelor of Science (maths, physics, computer science, economics, chemistry, biology double majors). Merit-based Excellence Scholarships of €4,800 per year for three years go to the very best applicants admitted with honours, who are told how to apply on admission.

Need-based aid for international students comes as a tuition fee waiver and/or an interest-free loan; merit and need aid can be combined. Any nationality can apply (Georgia and Qatar included). Applicants submit online, shortlisted candidates have a 50-minute video interview in English, and financial aid results come after admission results.

en: €4,800/year Excellence Scholarship for 3 years
Need-based fee waivers and 0% loans
No nationality quotas

eligibility.en: Applicants of any nationality to the École Polytechnique Bachelor of Science; Excellence Scholarship only for students admitted with honours; need-based aid requires a financial aid application.

en: Apply online via Polytechnique's application system (Round 2 deadline 6 Jan 2027; Round 3 8 Feb 2027).
Request need-based aid in your application if needed.
Shortlisted applicants do a remote interview in English.
If admitted with honours, follow the instructions to apply for the Excellence Scholarship.

costs.en: Excellence Scholarship €4,800 per year for 3 years; need-based tuition waiver and/or interest-free loan. All students pay the annual administration fee.

score_reason: Elite STEM bachelor with merit + need aid and clear 2027 deadlines.

name.en: École Polytechnique Full Scholarship for International Olympiad Medalists (Bachelor)
name.ka: École Polytechnique-ის სრული სტიპენდია საერთაშორისო ოლიმპიადების პრიზიორებისთვის (ბაკალავრიატი)
name.ar: منحة كاملة من المدرسة متعددة التقنيات للحاصلين على ميداليات الأولمبيادات الدولية (البكالوريوس)

deadline_note: Apply through the regular Bachelor rounds: Round 2 closes 6 Jan 2027, Round 3 closes 8 Feb 2027. Medal must be from the two years before enrolment.

summary.en: École Polytechnique offers a limited number of full scholarships, worth up to €87,900 for non-EU students, to International Olympiad medalists admitted to its Bachelor of Science. Gold medalists get priority.
summary.ka: École Polytechnique ბაკალავრიატზე მიღებულ საერთაშორისო ოლიმპიადების პრიზიორებს შეზღუდული რაოდენობის სრულ სტიპენდიას სთავაზობს, არა-EU სტუდენტებისთვის €87,900-მდე. ოქროს მედლის მფლობელებს უპირატესობა აქვთ.
summary.ar: تقدم المدرسة متعددة التقنيات عدداً محدوداً من المنح الكاملة، تصل إلى 87,900 يورو لطلاب خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي، للحاصلين على ميداليات الأولمبيادات الدولية المقبولين في بكالوريوس العلوم، مع أولوية للميداليات الذهبية.

about.en:
For students who won a medal at an International Science Olympiad (e.g. maths, physics, chemistry, informatics, biology) in the two years before enrolment, École Polytechnique offers full scholarships for its three-year Bachelor of Science. Tuition is waived (except the €1,500 annual administration fee) and a living allowance is paid in 10 monthly instalments; the maximum is €87,900 per non-EU/EEA student and €78,750 per EU/EEA student.

Gold medalists have priority and an official certificate of the result is required. Renewal depends on academic success and conduct, and it cannot be combined with other Polytechnique or French government aid. Medalists from Georgia, Qatar and every country can apply.

en: Up to €87,900: tuition + living allowance
For International Olympiad medalists
Top French STEM school, taught in English

eligibility.en: Applicants admitted to the Bachelor of Science who won one or more medals at a listed International Olympiad in the two years before enrolment (priority to gold).

en: Apply to the Bachelor of Science in Round 2 (by 6 Jan 2027) or Round 3 (by 8 Feb 2027).
Declare your Olympiad medal and upload the official certificate.
Complete the interview if shortlisted.
Receive the financial aid decision after admission results.

costs.en: Tuition waived (except €1,500 annual administration fee) plus monthly living allowance; total up to €87,900 (non-EU) over the programme.

score_reason: Fully funded STEM bachelor for olympiad medalists of any country.

name.ka: ISU Bocconi-ის სტიპენდია — ბაკალავრიატის პირველი კურსი 2027-28
name.ar: منحة ISU Bocconi — السنة الأولى من البكالوريوس 2027-28

deadline_note: International candidates in the Early Session/HEC 1st round apply 12–30 Nov 2026; Winter Session window 15 Mar – 5 Apr 2027. You must first submit the 'Bocconi4Access to Education 2027-28' application. Page marked 'being updated'.

summary.en: Bocconi's right-to-study scholarship gives first-year bachelor's students with limited family income a grant plus related services such as accommodation. International students apply in a short window tied to their admission session.
summary.ka: ბოკონის სწავლის უფლების სტიპენდია შეზღუდული ოჯახური შემოსავლის მქონე პირველკურსელ ბაკალავრებს გრანტს და დაკავშირებულ მომსახურებას, მაგალითად საცხოვრებელს, აძლევს. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტები მისაღები სესიის შესაბამის მოკლე ვადაში აპლიკირებენ.
summary.ar: تمنح منحة الحق في الدراسة في بوكوني طلاب السنة الأولى من البكالوريوس ذوي الدخل العائلي المحدود منحة مالية وخدمات مرتبطة مثل السكن، ويتقدم الطلاب الدوليون في نافذة قصيرة مرتبطة بدورة القبول.

about.en:
The ISU Bocconi Scholarship is Bocconi's right-to-study award (the Lombardy 'diritto allo studio' system) for students enrolled in Bachelor of Science and Law programmes, as well as MSc and PhD. It combines a grant with related services and supplements (such as accommodation) and is renewable each year if you meet merit (credit) requirements.

International students are eligible when they meet the economic, enrolment and merit requirements. First-year bachelor's candidates must first submit the single 'Bocconi4Access to Education' application and then the ISU application in the window for their admission session: 12–30 November 2026 for international candidates in the Early Session, or 15 March – 5 April 2027 for the Winter Session.

en: Grant plus housing services
Renewable every year on merit
Linked to Bocconi4Access tuition waivers

eligibility.en: Students admitted to the first year of a Bocconi Bachelor of Science or Law programme in 2027-28 who meet economic (family income/assets) requirements; any nationality, including Georgia and Qatar.

en: Apply for admission to a Bocconi bachelor's (Early or Winter Session).
Submit the 'Bocconi4Access to Education 2027-28' application.
Submit the ISU Bocconi Scholarship application in your session's window (Early: 12–30 Nov 2026; Winter: 15 Mar – 5 Apr 2027).
Provide the required family income and asset documents.
Earn the required credits to keep the award in later years.

costs.en: Annual grant amount depends on family economic situation and whether you live away from home; includes services and supplements such as accommodation.

score_reason: Substantial need-based support at a top business school; first window opens Nov 2026.

name.ka: UCSC-ის საერთაშორისო სტიპენდია — ინგლისურენოვანი ბაკალავრიატი (კატოლიკა, მილანი)

duration.en: Full length of the bachelor's degree

deadline_note: 2027/28 application window for the BA in International Relations and Global Affairs: 4 Nov 2026 – 17 Feb 2027; the scholarship is requested in the same online application.

summary.en: Cattolica in Milan cuts tuition for students whose family income is earned outside the EU from €8,800 to €5,900 a year. You request it in your online application and it renews automatically.
summary.ka: მილანის კატოლიკა იმ სტუდენტებისთვის, რომელთა ოჯახის შემოსავალი EU-ს გარეთაა, სწავლის საფასურს წელიწადში €8,800-დან €5,900-მდე ამცირებს. მოთხოვნა ონლაინ განაცხადშივე ხდება და ავტომატურად ახლდება.
summary.ar: تخفض جامعة كاتوليكا في ميلانو الرسوم للطلاب الذين يُكتسب دخل أسرهم خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي من 8,800 إلى 5,900 يورو سنوياً، ويُطلب ذلك ضمن الطلب الإلكتروني ويتجدد تلقائياً.

about.en:
Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore, one of Europe's largest private universities, charges a flat €8,800 a year for English-taught bachelor's students whose family income is produced outside the EU. The UCSC International Scholarship lowers this to €5,900 a year for the whole degree.

You apply for it during the online admission application (for example to the three-year BA in International Relations and Global Affairs) and hear with your admission offer. It renews automatically for up to three years beyond normal study time and cannot be combined with EDUCatt need-based aid. Students from Georgia, Qatar and any non-EU country are eligible.

en: Tuition cut to €5,900 a year
Requested in your admission application
Renews automatically each year

eligibility.en: Applicants to Cattolica's English-taught bachelor's whose family income is produced in non-EU countries; any nationality.

en: Apply online to the bachelor's programme (window 4 Nov 2026 – 17 Feb 2027).
Tick/request the UCSC International Scholarship in the application.
Receive the decision together with your admission offer.
Pay the reduced fee in five instalments.

costs.en: Reduces annual tuition and fees from €8,800 to €5,900 (about 33% off).

score_reason: Reliable fee cut for all non-EU applicants; clear Feb 2027 deadline.

name.en: Politecnico di Milano DSU Right-to-Study Scholarship (Bachelor's 2027/28)
name.ar: منحة الحق في الدراسة DSU في بوليتكنيكو دي ميلانو (البكالوريوس 2027/28)

deadline_note: Estimated: PoliMi publishes the DSU call every June; the 2027/28 deadline will be set in the call (you can apply before enrolling or even before the admission test). Check the call for the exact date.

summary.en: Bachelor's students admitted to Politecnico di Milano can apply for the regional DSU scholarship: cash plus services such as meals and housing, based on family income (ISEE) and later on merit.
summary.ka: მილანის პოლიტექნიკოზე მიღებულ ბაკალავრებს შეუძლიათ რეგიონული DSU სტიპენდიის მოთხოვნა: ფულადი თანხა და მომსახურება, მაგალითად კვება და საცხოვრებელი, ოჯახის შემოსავლის (ISEE) და შემდგომ აკადემიური მოსწრების მიხედვით.
summary.ar: يمكن لطلاب البكالوريوس المقبولين في بوليتكنيكو دي ميلانو التقدم لمنحة DSU الإقليمية: مبلغ نقدي وخدمات مثل الوجبات والسكن، بناءً على دخل الأسرة (ISEE) ثم على الجدارة لاحقاً.

about.en:
Diritto allo Studio Universitario (DSU) is Italy's right-to-study system. Every June, Politecnico di Milano publishes a call for DSU benefits: a scholarship made of money and services (notably canteen meals), with higher amounts for students living away from home, plus possible accommodation. International students, including non-EU students, are eligible.

You must obtain an ISEE 'for university use' (for foreign income, a parificato ISEE built from family documents from your home country) below the call's limit. First-year students qualify on income; later years also require a minimum number of credits. You can submit before enrolling, even before taking the admission test.

en: Cash + meals + housing support
Open to international students
Apply before you even enrol

eligibility.en: Students enrolling in a PoliMi Bachelor of Science (any nationality) whose family ISEE for university use is within the call's limit; renewal requires minimum credits.

en: Get admitted to (or apply for) a PoliMi Bachelor of Science (English- or Italian-taught).
Collect family income and asset documents from your home country (legalised/translated) for the ISEE parificato.
Request the ISEE 'for university use' within the call's deadlines.
Submit the DSU form in PoliMi Online Services > Benefits and agreements > DSU Benefits.

costs.en: Scholarship (money + free/discounted meals), higher for students living away from home; may include accommodation and tuition exemption under the call's rules.

score_reason: Substantial need-based support at a top technical university; call opens June 2027.

name.en: DSU Toscana Right-to-Study Scholarship (Pisa, Florence, Siena) 2027/28

deadline_note: Estimated: the 2026/27 call closed 7 Sep 2026 (1:00 pm); the 2027/28 call is expected in summer 2027 with a similar early-September deadline.

summary.en: Tuscany's regional DSU scholarship covers tuition fees, a free place in student housing (or rent subsidy), free canteen meals and a cash allowance for students at Pisa, Florence and Siena. Students from any country can apply.
summary.ka: ტოსკანის რეგიონული DSU სტიპენდია პიზის, ფლორენციისა და სიენის სტუდენტებს უფარავს სწავლის საფასურს, უფასო საცხოვრებელს (ან ქირის სუბსიდიას), უფასო კვებასა და ფულად დახმარებას. ნებისმიერი ქვეყნის სტუდენტს შეუძლია განაცხადის შეტანა.
summary.ar: تغطي منحة DSU الإقليمية في توسكانا لطلاب بيزا وفلورنسا وسيينا الرسوم الدراسية ومكاناً مجانياً في السكن الطلابي (أو دعماً للإيجار) ووجبات مجانية ومخصصاً نقدياً، ويمكن لطلاب أي دولة التقدّم.

about.en:
DSU Toscana is the regional right-to-study agency for universities in Tuscany, including the University of Pisa, University of Florence and University of Siena. Its scholarship gives eligible students exemption from tuition fees, a free bed in a university residence or a rent subsidy for students living away from home, free meals in DSU canteens and a cash allowance for books and other expenses.

It is open to students from any country enrolling in a bachelor's, single-cycle or master's degree, provided they do not already hold a qualification at the same level and meet the income/asset limits. Non-EU students submit family income documents from their home country (Appendix B of the call). The amount depends on economic conditions and whether you are on-site, commuter or off-site.

en: Tuition exemption + free housing + free meals
Open to students from any country
Covers Pisa, Florence and Siena universities

eligibility.en: Students of any nationality enrolling in or enrolled at a Tuscan university (bachelor's included) who meet economic requirements and do not already hold a degree at the same level.

en: Apply for admission to an English- or Italian-taught bachelor's at Pisa, Florence or Siena.
Gather family income/asset documents (translated and legalised) as listed in Appendix B of the call.
Submit the DSU application online through 'Sportello Studente' by the call's deadline (early September).
Check the ranking lists and accommodation assignments.

costs.en: Tuition exemption, accommodation or rent subsidy, free meals and a cash allowance; amount varies by economic situation and student status.

score_reason: Near-full support (fees, housing, meals) for low-income students of any nationality.

summary.ar: تمنح جامعة لينكون كل طالب بكالوريوس دولي مؤهل يبدأ في سبتمبر 2027 خصماً قدره 2,000 جنيه عن كل سنة دراسية، دون الحاجة إلى طلب.

about.en:
The University of Lincoln offers Global Undergraduate Scholarships worth £2,000 per year as a tuition fee discount for full-time overseas-fee students joining an undergraduate programme in September 2027.

You must meet your programme's entry requirements and apply to Lincoln before Monday 16 August 2027. Any nationality qualifies (including Georgia and Qatar). The discount does not apply during placement or study-abroad years, and some advanced-entry students from China are excluded.

en: £2,000 off every year
Automatic, no form
Apply by 16 Aug 2027

eligibility.en: Full-time overseas-fee undergraduates starting in September 2027 who meet entry requirements and apply before 16 August 2027.

en: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027). Lincoln's scholarship cut-off is 16 August 2027.
Meet the entry requirements of your offer.
The discount is applied automatically each year.

costs.en: £2,000 tuition fee discount per year of study.

score_reason: Automatic multi-year award; modest amount.

summary.en: UWE Bristol offers international undergraduates up to £4,000 off first-year tuition, awarded at offer stage based on grades, personal statement, references and other factors. No application is needed.
summary.ka: UWE Bristol საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებს პირველი წლის საფასურზე £4,000-მდე ფასდაკლებას სთავაზობს, რომელიც შეთავაზების ეტაპზე ნიშნების, პირადი წერილის, რეკომენდაციების და სხვა ფაქტორების საფუძველზე ენიჭებათ.
summary.ar: تقدم جامعة UWE بريستول لطلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين خصماً يصل إلى 4,000 جنيه على رسوم السنة الأولى، يُمنح عند صدور العرض بناءً على الدرجات والبيان الشخصي والتوصيات وعوامل أخرى، دون طلب.

about.en:
UWE Bristol awards International Student Scholarships of up to £4,000 (first year only) to international fee payers joining undergraduate and postgraduate taught courses.

The university considers course choice, personal statement, academic references and performance, interviews, skills and experience and domicile, at its discretion. There is no application: successful candidates are contacted once an offer is made. Any nationality can be considered.

en: Up to £4,000 off first-year fees
No separate application
Bristol, one of the UK's top student cities

eligibility.en: International fee payers applying to UWE Bristol undergraduate courses; awarded at the university's discretion.

Write a strong personal statement and secure good references.
UWE contacts you about the scholarship when it makes your offer.

costs.en: Up to £4,000 off first-year tuition.

score_reason: Discretionary first-year discount, all nationalities.

summary.ar: تمنح جامعة سالفورد في مانشستر الكبرى طلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين المتفوقين خصماً قدره 3,500 جنيه عن كل سنة دراسية إذا حصلوا على عرض وحققوا ABB في A level أو ما يعادلها.

The Global Gold Excellence Scholarship supports high-achieving international students at the University of Salford with £3,500 off tuition for every year of an undergraduate degree (from September 2026 entry onwards; £3,000 for master's).

You must be starting the first year of a full-time eligible undergraduate programme, hold an offer and achieve ABB at A level or the equivalent from your country (equivalents on Salford's country pages). Self-funded students progressing from Salford's International Foundation Year with 70+ also qualify. Any nationality is eligible.

en: £3,500 off every year
ABB or equivalent
Close to Manchester and MediaCityUK

eligibility.en: International students entering year 1 of an eligible full-time undergraduate programme with an offer and ABB at A level (or equivalent).

en: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Meet the ABB (or equivalent) requirement.
The scholarship is confirmed with your offer/enrolment.

costs.en: £3,500 tuition fee reduction per year of study.

score_reason: Multi-year award with a reachable ABB threshold.

summary.ar: تمنح جامعة بليموث تلقائياً طلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين المستوفين لشروط القبول خصماً يصل إلى 6,000 جنيه: 4,000 في السنة الأولى و1,000 في كل سنة لاحقة.

The International Undergraduate Welcome to Plymouth Scholarship is offered automatically to any international student who meets the entry requirements for their course. For 2026/27 starters it was £4,000 off first-year fees, then £1,000 off in the second year and £1,000 in the final year (up to £6,000).

Plymouth is a coastal university known for marine science, nursing, medicine-related and engineering courses. All nationalities qualify.

en: Up to £6,000 over the degree
Automatic if you meet entry requirements
All nationalities

eligibility.en: International-fee undergraduate students who meet the entry requirements of their course.

en: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Meet the entry requirements in your offer.
The scholarship is applied automatically to your tuition fees.

costs.en: Fee reduction: £4,000 (year 1), £1,000 (year 2), £1,000 (final year), based on 2026/27 terms.

score_reason: Automatic award for all who meet entry requirements.

summary.ka: ყველა არა-EU საერთაშორისო სტუდენტი, რომელიც 2026/27 ან 2027/28 წელს Coventry University Group-ში სრულ განაკვეთზე სწავლას იწყებს, სწავლის ყოველ სრულ წელს £2,000-ს ზოგავს.
summary.ar: يوفر جميع الطلاب الدوليين من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي الذين يبدؤون درجة بدوام كامل في مجموعة جامعة كوفنتري في 2026/27 أو 2027/28 مبلغ 2,000 جنيه من الرسوم عن كل سنة دراسية كاملة.

en: £2,000 off every full year
Automatic for non-EU international students
Campuses in Coventry, London and Scarborough

score_reason: Automatic for every non-EU student; small amount.
