summary.en: Liverpool John Moores University takes £3,000–£4,500 off tuition for eligible international students. You don't apply separately; your status appears in your unconditional offer letter.
summary.ka: ლივერპულ ჯონ მურსის უნივერსიტეტი შესაბამის საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს სწავლის საფასურს £3,000–£4,500-ით უმცირებს. ცალკე განაცხადი საჭირო არ არის; სტატუსი უპირობო შეთავაზების წერილშია.
summary.ar: تخصم جامعة ليفربول جون مورز ما بين 3,000 و4,500 جنيه من رسوم الطلاب الدوليين المؤهلين، دون طلب منفصل؛ ويظهر وضع المنحة في خطاب العرض غير المشروط.

about.en:
LJMU's international scholarships range from £3,000 to £4,500 off tuition fees for undergraduate and postgraduate students. There is no separate application: if you meet the criteria, your scholarship status is shown in your unconditional offer letter.

You must hold an offer and have firmly accepted your place, not have already studied a degree at the same level at LJMU, and have funds for remaining costs. Courses with fees under £17,250 are excluded. Open to all international nationalities.

en: £3,000–£4,500 off tuition
No application
Shown in your offer letter

eligibility.en: International fee-paying offer holders who have firmly accepted their place on an eligible LJMU undergraduate course (fees ≥ £17,250).

en: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Firmly accept your LJMU offer.
Your scholarship status is confirmed in your unconditional offer letter.

costs.en: £3,000–£4,500 tuition reduction.

score_reason: Automatic award, all nationalities; modest.

name.ar: منحة Thrive في جامعة سوانزي (البكالوريوس الدولي)

duration.ar: 4,000 جنيه في السنة الأولى ثم 2,000 جنيه سنوياً

deadline_note: Automatic for eligible new self-funded undergraduates; no separate application. Check the Thrive Bursary terms for your intake.

summary.en: Swansea, in Wales, automatically takes £4,000 off first-year tuition and £2,000 off each later year for self-funded undergraduates from 28 countries, including Qatar, Türkiye, Egypt and the Gulf states.
summary.ka: უელსის სუონსის უნივერსიტეტი 28 ქვეყნის, მათ შორის კატარის, თურქეთის, ეგვიპტისა და სპარსეთის ყურის ქვეყნების, თვითდაფინანსებულ ბაკალავრებს ავტომატურად აკლებს პირველი წლის საფასურს £4,000-ს, შემდეგ წლებში კი £2,000-ს.
summary.ar: تخصم جامعة سوانزي في ويلز تلقائياً 4,000 جنيه من رسوم السنة الأولى و2,000 جنيه من كل سنة لاحقة لطلاب البكالوريوس ذاتيي التمويل من 28 دولة منها قطر وتركيا ومصر ودول الخليج.

about.en:
Swansea University's Thrive Bursary gives new self-funding international undergraduates a £4,000 tuition fee reduction in the first year, followed by a £2,000 progression bursary in each later year.

You must be domiciled in one of: Bahrain, Bangladesh, Botswana, Egypt, Ghana, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Jordan, Kenya, Kuwait, Lebanon, Malaysia, Morocco, Nigeria, Oman, Pakistan, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, Tanzania, Thailand, Türkiye, UAE, Uganda, Uzbekistan, Vietnam or Zimbabwe. Georgia is not on the list (Swansea's International Excellence Scholarships are open to all). Awarded automatically.

en: £4,000 + £2,000 each later year
Qatar and Gulf states eligible
Automatic

eligibility.en: New self-funding international undergraduates domiciled in one of 28 listed countries (Qatar included; Georgia not listed).

en: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Accept your offer and enrol as a self-funded student.
The bursary is applied automatically to your tuition fees.

costs.en: £4,000 off year-1 tuition; £2,000 off each subsequent year.

score_reason: Automatic multi-year bursary that explicitly covers Qatar.

name.ar: منحة التميز الدولية في جامعة سوانزي (البكالوريوس)

duration.en: Up to £5,000 in year 1 (+£2,000 in year 2)
duration.ar: حتى 5,000 جنيه في السنة الأولى (+2,000 في الثانية)

deadline_note: The January/March 2027 entry round closes 27 Nov 2026 at 12:00 GMT. The September 2027 round opens later (sign up on the page to be notified).

summary.en: Swansea awards International Excellence Scholarships of up to £5,000 off first-year tuition to high-achieving overseas undergraduates, plus £2,000 in year two for top awardees who keep a 70% average.
summary.ka: სუონსი მაღალი მოსწრების საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებს პირველი წლის საფასურზე £5,000-მდე ექსელენსის სტიპენდიას ანიჭებს, საუკეთესოებს კი, რომლებიც 70%-იან საშუალოს ინარჩუნებენ, მეორე წელს დამატებით £2,000-ს.
summary.ar: تمنح جامعة سوانزي طلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين المتفوقين منح تميز تصل إلى 5,000 جنيه من رسوم السنة الأولى، مع 2,000 جنيه إضافية في السنة الثانية للمتفوقين الذين يحافظون على معدل 70%.

about.en:
Swansea University offers a number of International Excellence Scholarships to overseas students who have demonstrated academic excellence or show the potential to do so. Awards are tuition fee discounts worth up to £5,000 in the first year, with a further £2,000 in year 2 for £5,000 awardees who achieve a 70% average.

They are open to all nationalities (including Georgia and Qatar) and require an application. The round for January and March 2027 entry closes on 27 November 2026; the September 2027 round opens later in the cycle.

en: All nationalities
Separate rounds for Jan/Mar and Sept entry

eligibility.en: Overseas-fee undergraduate applicants of any nationality with strong academic records.

en: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027). (or apply directly for January/March starts).
Complete the online International Excellence Scholarship application in your intake's round.
January/March 2027 entry: submit by 12:00 GMT, 27 November 2026; Sept 2027: watch for the round opening.

costs.en: Up to £5,000 off first-year tuition; £2,000 in year 2 for top awardees with a 70% average.

score_reason: Open to all; imminent Jan-entry deadline, Sept round later.

name.ar: منحة جامعة يونشوبينغ (البكالوريوس، خريف 2027)

duration.en: Full length of the bachelor's degree

deadline_note: Official: the scholarship application for programmes starting Autumn 2027 is open 16 Oct 2026 – 2 May 2027. You must have applied to a JU programme by then.

summary.en: Jönköping University in Sweden covers 10–30% of tuition for fee-paying international students admitted to its English-taught bachelor's and master's programmes, based on academic merit.
summary.ka: შვედეთის იონშეპინგის უნივერსიტეტი ინგლისურენოვან ბაკალავრიატსა და მაგისტრატურაზე მიღებულ საფასურის გადამხდელ საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს აკადემიური მოსწრების მიხედვით სწავლის საფასურის 10–30%-ს უფარავს.
summary.ar: تغطي جامعة يونشوبينغ في السويد 10–30% من الرسوم الدراسية للطلاب الدوليين الملزمين بالرسوم والمقبولين في برامج البكالوريوس والماجستير بالإنجليزية، بناءً على الجدارة الأكاديمية.

about.en:
Jönköping University (JU), known for its International Business School and engineering, offers merit-based scholarships worth 10%, 20% or 30% of the tuition fee for the bachelor's or master's programme a student is admitted to.

Applicants must be citizens of a country required to pay tuition in Sweden (all non-EU/EEA countries, including Georgia and Qatar), have applied to an on-site JU programme and submit a complete scholarship application. You can apply before receiving your programme offer. It cannot be combined with JU's partner-organisation scholarships (FIDERH, FUNED, COLFUTURO).

en: 10–30% of tuition for the whole programme
Apply 16 Oct 2026 – 2 May 2027
All non-EU/EEA nationalities

eligibility.en: Citizens of countries required to pay tuition in Sweden who have applied to an on-site JU bachelor's or master's programme starting Autumn 2027.

en: Apply for a JU bachelor's programme via University Admissions in Sweden (universityadmissions.se), round closing mid-January.
Submit the JU scholarship application between 16 Oct 2026 and 2 May 2027.
Receive the decision after admission results.

costs.en: Covers 10%, 20% or 30% of tuition fees.

score_reason: Clear 2027 window; partial award for all non-EU students.

name.en: University of Lancashire (UCLan) Excellence Scholarship — International
name.ar: منحة التميز في جامعة لانكشاير (UCLan) — للطلاب الدوليين

duration.ar: 3,500 جنيه في السنة الأولى، قابلة للتجديد بمعدل 60%+

deadline_note: Year of entry 2027/28 confirmed on the official page; automatic, no deadline beyond course application dates.

summary.en: The University of Lancashire (UCLan) automatically gives international undergraduates who meet enhanced entry criteria £3,500 off first-year tuition, renewable each year with a 60%+ average. Georgia is among the many eligible countries.
summary.ka: ლანკაშირის უნივერსიტეტი (UCLan) გაძლიერებული მოთხოვნების დამაკმაყოფილებელ საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებს პირველი წლის საფასურს ავტომატურად £3,500-ით უმცირებს, 60%+ საშუალოთი ყოველწლიურად განახლებადი. საქართველო ბევრ შესაბამის ქვეყანას შორისაა.
summary.ar: تخصم جامعة لانكشاير (UCLan) تلقائياً 3,500 جنيه من رسوم السنة الأولى لطلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين المستوفين لمعايير قبول معززة، وتتجدد سنوياً بمعدل 60%+، وجورجيا من بين الدول المؤهلة.

about.en:
The Excellence Scholarship is the University of Lancashire's (formerly UCLan) merit award for international students who meet high, country-specific entry criteria. For 2027/28 entry it is worth £3,500 in the first year, and later years are funded if you achieve an average mark above 60%.

It is applied automatically as a fee reduction for undergraduate and postgraduate taught students from a long list of countries, including Georgia, and can be combined with other awards up to £5,500 a year.

en: £3,500 a year with 60%+ average
Automatic, no application
Georgia among eligible countries

eligibility.en: International students from listed countries (Georgia included) who meet the enhanced country-specific academic entry criteria for their programme.

en: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027). (or apply directly).
Meet the enhanced entry criteria for your country (ask the International Team).
The reduction is applied automatically; keep a 60%+ average to renew.

costs.en: £3,500 tuition fee reduction in year 1; subsequent years subject to an average above 60%. Combinable up to £5,500/year.

score_reason: Automatic and renewable; explicitly includes Georgia.

name.ar: منحة التميز لبرنامج BBA الدولي في EDHEC

duration.en: Up to 25% of total tuition for 4 years

deadline_note: Only Round 1 (closed 3 Nov 2026) and Round 2 (5 Nov 2026 – 7 Jan 2027) applicants are eligible. Results 18 Feb 2027. Confirmed for the 2027 intake.

summary.en: EDHEC's four-year International BBA automatically considers international applicants in rounds 1–2 for an Excellence Scholarship worth up to 25% of total tuition. No separate application is needed.
summary.ka: EDHEC-ის ოთხწლიანი საერთაშორისო BBA პირველ-მეორე რაუნდის საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტებს ავტომატურად განიხილავს ექსელენსის სტიპენდიისთვის, რომელიც სწავლის საფასურის 25%-მდეა. ცალკე განაცხადი საჭირო არ არის.
summary.ar: يأخذ برنامج BBA الدولي لمدة أربع سنوات في EDHEC المتقدمين الدوليين في الجولتين الأولى والثانية تلقائياً بعين الاعتبار لمنحة تميز تصل إلى 25% من إجمالي الرسوم، دون طلب منفصل.

about.en:
EDHEC, one of France's top business schools, offers a four-year International BBA taught in English on its Lille and Nice campuses, with Business Management (€15,900/year) and Global Business (€23,900/year) tracks. Excellence Scholarships cut up to 25% of total tuition for international students.

Candidates who apply in Round 1 or Round 2 of the international session are automatically considered (merit-based) and are told with their admission offer. Selection includes an online interview. Any non-French-baccalaureate international applicant, including from Georgia and Qatar, is eligible.

en: Up to 25% off the 4-year tuition
Automatic with your application
Apply by 7 Jan 2027 (Round 2)

eligibility.en: International applicants (not holders of the French baccalauréat) applying to the EDHEC International BBA in Round 1 or 2 for the 2027 intake.

en: Apply online to the EDHEC International BBA by 7 January 2027 (Round 2); €100 application fee.
Take the online interview (28 Jan – 9 Feb 2027).
Receive your admission decision and any scholarship on 18 Feb 2027.
Pay the €5,000 deposit within two weeks to enrol.

costs.en: Up to 25% discount on total tuition (tuition €15,900–€23,900 per year before scholarships).

score_reason: Solid merit discount at a top French business school; Jan 2027 deadline.

name.en: American University of Paris Undergraduate Merit Scholarships and Need-Based Tuition Awards
name.ka: პარიზის ამერიკული უნივერსიტეტის საბაკალავრო აკადემიური სტიპენდიები და საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული დახმარება
name.ar: منح الجدارة ومساعدات الرسوم حسب الحاجة للبكالوريوس في الجامعة الأمريكية في باريس

duration.en: Full length of the bachelor's degree

deadline_note: Merit awards are automatic at admission; need-based awards require a financial aid application with your admission file. Rolling admissions for Fall 2027 — apply early, as award offers can be time-limited.

summary.en: AUP gives over €6 million a year in aid to undergraduates of all nationalities; about half receive support, sometimes up to 75% of tuition. Merit awards are automatic and need-based awards need a short application.
summary.ka: AUP ყოველწლიურად €6 მილიონზე მეტ დახმარებას აძლევს ყველა ქვეყნის ბაკალავრებს; დაახლოებით ნახევარი იღებს მხარდაჭერას, ზოგჯერ სწავლის საფასურის 75%-მდე. აკადემიური ჯილდოები ავტომატურია, საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებულისთვის კი მოკლე განაცხადია საჭირო.
summary.ar: تمنح الجامعة الأمريكية في باريس أكثر من 6 ملايين يورو سنوياً لطلاب البكالوريوس من جميع الجنسيات، ويحصل نحو نصفهم على دعم يصل أحياناً إلى 75% من الرسوم. منح الجدارة تلقائية، أما المنح حسب الحاجة فتتطلب طلباً قصيراً.

about.en:
The American University of Paris is an English-language liberal arts university in central Paris with students from over 100 countries. It awards more than €6 million every year; around 50% of students receive financial aid, in some cases as high as 75% of tuition, as tuition abatements.

Merit awards and scholarships (including automatic IB Diploma scholarships) are based on your profile and are considered automatically at admission. Need-based Tuition Awards combine your admission file with a financial aid application documenting family need. All nationalities are eligible, including Georgia and Qatar. Awards are renewable if you keep the required GPA.

en: ~50% of students get aid; up to 75% of tuition
Automatic merit awards + IB scholarships
English-taught liberal arts in central Paris

eligibility.en: First-year undergraduate degree applicants of any nationality. Need-based awards require a complete financial aid application; visiting/first-year-abroad students are not eligible.

en: Apply for undergraduate admission to AUP (Fall 2027).
You are automatically considered for merit awards at admission.
For need-based aid, complete the tuition award application and financial documents.
Respond to your award letter by the date stated on it.

costs.en: Tuition abatements from merit and need-based awards, up to about 75% of tuition in some cases.

score_reason: Generous merit + need aid open to all nationalities in Paris.

name.en: Bard College Berlin Scholarships and Need-Based Financial Aid (BA)
name.ka: Bard College Berlin-ის სტიპენდიები და საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული დახმარება (BA)
name.ar: منح ومساعدات مالية حسب الحاجة في كلية بارد برلين (البكالوريوس)

duration.en: Full length of the bachelor's degree

deadline_note: Regular Decision financial aid form due 10 Jan 2027 (Early Action was 1 Nov 2026); late admission (EU/EEA and some countries only) 1 May 2027.

summary.en: Bard College Berlin, an English-language liberal arts college, gives need-based aid covering 10% to 100% of its comprehensive fee to students of any nationality; 82% of undergraduates receive support.
summary.ka: Bard College Berlin, ინგლისურენოვანი ლიბერალური ხელოვნების კოლეჯი, ნებისმიერი ქვეყნის სტუდენტებს საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებულ დახმარებას აძლევს, რომელიც ყოვლისმომცველი საფასურის 10%-დან 100%-მდე ფარავს; ბაკალავრების 82% მხარდაჭერას იღებს.
summary.ar: تقدم كلية بارد برلين، وهي كلية فنون ليبرالية ناطقة بالإنجليزية، مساعدات حسب الحاجة تغطي من 10% إلى 100% من الرسوم الشاملة لطلاب أي جنسية، ويحصل 82% من طلاب البكالوريوس على دعم.

about.en:
Bard College Berlin offers four-year BA degrees in humanities, arts and social thought, taught in English in a small residential college. Aid is awarded on demonstrated financial need regardless of nationality: in 2026-27, 82% of undergraduates received BCB aid, with an average scholarship of €15,125 against an average annual cost of €22,572; awards range from €3,000 a year to the full comprehensive fee.

One financial aid application automatically considers you for every scholarship you qualify for. Recipients typically have a predicted IB of 34+, Abitur 1.0–1.5 or US GPA 3.7+. Students from Georgia, Qatar and all countries can apply; prior degree holders are not eligible.

en: 10–100% of the comprehensive fee
82% of students receive aid
One form for all scholarships

eligibility.en: Applicants of any nationality to the BA or Academy Year with demonstrated financial need; strong academics (e.g. IB 34+). Not for students who already hold a degree.

en: Apply for admission to the BA (Regular Decision).
Submit the financial aid application with family financial documents by 10 January 2027.
Receive your aid decision in late March 2027.
Pay the deposit by 1 May 2027.

costs.en: Scholarships from €3,000/year up to the full comprehensive fee (tuition + housing); average BCB scholarship €15,125/year.

score_reason: Very generous need-based aid at an English-taught Berlin college.

name.ar: منحة الذكرى العشرين لجامعة موديول فيينا (2027/28)

duration.en: Full length of the bachelor's degree

deadline_note: New call for 2027/28 entrants (20 places). Apply with your admission application and follow MU's semester application deadlines; Early Bird admission deadline for fall is 15 March. Exact scholarship cut-off is in the official call PDF.

summary.en: To mark its 20th anniversary, Modul University Vienna is awarding 20 scholarships of 40%, 60% or 80% off tuition to new bachelor's and master's students for 2027/28, based on potential, motivation and financial need.
summary.ka: მე-20 წლისთავთან დაკავშირებით მოდულის უნივერსიტეტი ვენაში 2027/28 წლისთვის ახალ ბაკალავრებსა და მაგისტრანტებს 20 სტიპენდიას აძლევს — სწავლის საფასურის 40%, 60% ან 80% — პოტენციალის, მოტივაციისა და ფინანსური საჭიროების მიხედვით.
summary.ar: بمناسبة ذكراها العشرين، تمنح جامعة موديول فيينا 20 منحة تغطي 40% أو 60% أو 80% من الرسوم لطلاب البكالوريوس والماجستير الجدد لعام 2027/28، بناءً على الإمكانات والدافعية والحاجة المالية.

about.en:
Modul University Vienna is a private, English-taught university specialising in tourism and hospitality, business, sustainability and new media. For its 20th anniversary it is awarding 20 scholarships to new students starting any bachelor's or MSc programme in 2027/28. Awards cover 40%, 60% or 80% of tuition (remaining undergraduate tuition €5,400, €3,600 or €1,800 per year).

Selection is holistic: academic potential (and keeping an 80% GPA), financial need, motivation and extracurricular involvement. Shortlisted candidates have an online interview with an admissions coordinator and two scholarship committee members. Open to all nationalities, including Georgia and Qatar.

en: 40%, 60% or 80% off tuition
Only 20 places
Holistic: merit + need + motivation

eligibility.en: New applicants for 2027/28 to any MU bachelor's or MSc programme who meet academic requirements and show financial need, academic potential, motivation and extracurricular involvement.

en: Apply for admission to an MU bachelor's programme for 2027/28.
Submit the scholarship application documents described in the official call.
Attend an online interview with the admissions and scholarship committee if invited.
Keep a minimum 80% GPA to retain the award.

costs.en: Tuition reduction of 40%, 60% or 80%; remaining undergraduate tuition €5,400 / €3,600 / €1,800 per year.

score_reason: Large awards but only 20 places.

name.ar: منحة الشرف للسنة الأولى في الجامعة الأنجلو-أمريكية في براغ

deadline_note: Awarded to first-year undergraduates who meet the grade and English thresholds; follows AAU's rolling admission deadlines for Fall 2027.

summary.en: Anglo-American University in Prague gives new undergraduates 30% or 50% off part of their tuition if they meet high grade and English-test thresholds (e.g. IB 32/34, A-levels ABB/AAB, IELTS 7.0/8.0).
summary.ka: პრაღის ანგლო-ამერიკული უნივერსიტეტი ახალ ბაკალავრებს სწავლის საფასურის ნაწილზე 30%-იან ან 50%-იან ფასდაკლებას აძლევს, თუ ისინი მაღალ ნიშნებსა და ინგლისურის ზღვრებს აკმაყოფილებენ (მაგ., IB 32/34, A-levels ABB/AAB, IELTS 7.0/8.0).
summary.ar: تمنح الجامعة الأنجلو-أمريكية في براغ طلاب البكالوريوس الجدد خصماً بنسبة 30% أو 50% على جزء من الرسوم إذا حققوا حدوداً عالية في الدرجات واختبارات الإنجليزية (مثل IB 32/34 وA-levels ABB/AAB وIELTS 7.0/8.0).

about.en:
Anglo-American University (AAU) is a private, English-language university in central Prague offering US-accredited bachelor's degrees in business, international relations, journalism, law, humanities and more. Its First-Year Honors Scholarship rewards outstanding new undergraduates on prior academic achievement plus English proficiency.

The 50% level needs e.g. GPA 3.8, IB 34, A-levels AAB or AP 5-5-4, plus IELTS 8.0 / SAT ERW 700; the 30% level needs GPA 3.5, IB 32, A-levels ABB, plus IELTS 7.0 / SAT ERW 650. The discount applies to a portion of first-year tuition (upfront or 10% per semester). Any nationality can qualify.

en: 30% or 50% off part of first-year tuition
Clear grade and English thresholds
US-accredited degrees in Prague

eligibility.en: New first-year undergraduates at AAU meeting both an academic threshold (GPA/IB/A-level/AP/Maturita) and an English proficiency threshold.

en: Apply for undergraduate admission to AAU for Fall 2027.
Submit transcripts and an English test (IELTS, TOEFL, CAE, SAT ERW, etc.).
If you meet the thresholds, the honors scholarship is applied to your tuition.

costs.en: 30% or 50% discount on a portion of tuition in the first year (not redeemable in cash).

score_reason: Transparent thresholds; modest one-year discount.

name.ar: منح الطلاب الجدد في جامعة ويبستر فيينا الخاصة (البكالوريوس)

deadline_note: Fall 2027 scholarship window for newly admitted students: 1 March – 31 May 2027 (13:00 CET). A separate window exists for Spring entry.

summary.en: Webster Vienna awards newly admitted bachelor's students €4,000, €7,000 or €12,000 per academic year based on GPA, English level, financial need, an essay and recommendations.
summary.ka: Webster Vienna ახლად მიღებულ ბაკალავრებს აკადემიურ წელიწადში €4,000-ს, €7,000-ს ან €12,000-ს ანიჭებს GPA-ს, ინგლისურის დონის, ფინანსური საჭიროების, ესესა და რეკომენდაციების მიხედვით.
summary.ar: تمنح جامعة ويبستر فيينا طلاب البكالوريوس المقبولين حديثاً 4,000 أو 7,000 أو 12,000 يورو لكل عام دراسي بناءً على المعدل ومستوى الإنجليزية والحاجة المالية والمقال والتوصيات.

about.en:
Webster Vienna Private University, the Austrian campus of the US-based Webster University, offers English-taught bachelor's degrees in Business Administration, International Relations, Psychology and Strategic Communication with dual Austrian/US accreditation.

Its New Student Scholarships come in three levels per academic year: Distinction €12,000 (GPA 3.5+, C1 English, significant need, excellent essay and references), Merit €7,000 (GPA 3.0+, B2, significant need) and Honors €4,000 (GPA 3.0+, B2, need). They are partial awards; the remaining tuition must be paid. Open to all nationalities.

en: Up to €12,000 per year
Three levels: €4k / €7k / €12k
Apply 1 Mar – 31 May 2027 for Fall

eligibility.en: Newly accepted undergraduates (Fall or Spring) with GPA 3.0+ (3.5+ for Distinction), B2–C1 English, financial need, essay and recommendations.

en: Apply and get admitted to a Webster Vienna bachelor's programme.
Submit the scholarship application with essay, recommendations and financial information between 1 March and 31 May 2027.
Receive the award decision for the Fall semester.

costs.en: €12,000, €7,000 or €4,000 per academic year (partial; remaining tuition payable).

score_reason: Meaningful awards with clear 2027 window.

name.en: University of Nicosia Academic Merit Scholarships (Undergraduate)
name.ar: منح الجدارة الأكاديمية في جامعة نيقوسيا (البكالوريوس)

duration.en: First year, then up to 50% each semester on GPA
duration.ka: პირველი წელი, შემდეგ სემესტრულად 50%-მდე GPA-ის მიხედვით
duration.ar: السنة الأولى، ثم حتى 50% كل فصل حسب المعدل

deadline_note: Rolling: first-year awards are based on your school-leaving certificate submitted with the application. Cyprus intakes are September and January.

summary.en: The University of Nicosia, Cyprus's largest university, reduces first-year tuition for students based on their high-school leaving grades, and later gives 10–50% off each semester for a GPA of 3.5 or more.
summary.ka: ნიქოზიის უნივერსიტეტი, კვიპროსის უდიდესი უნივერსიტეტი, პირველი წლის საფასურს სასკოლო ატესტატის ნიშნების მიხედვით ამცირებს, შემდეგ კი 3.5-ზე მაღალი GPA-სთვის ყოველ სემესტრს 10–50%-ს აკლებს.
summary.ar: تخفض جامعة نيقوسيا، أكبر جامعة في قبرص، رسوم السنة الأولى بناءً على درجات شهادة الثانوية، ثم تمنح خصماً بنسبة 10–50% كل فصل لمعدل 3.5 فأكثر.

about.en:
The University of Nicosia (UNIC) teaches most bachelor's degrees in English, including business, computing, law, pharmacy, psychology and the arts. First-year students receive an academic merit scholarship as a percentage reduction on tuition, based on the grades of their High School Leaving Certificate (scaled to the issuing country), valid for one year.

After two semesters, ongoing scholarships reward university performance: 50% for a 4.00 GPA, 20% for 3.75–3.99 and 10% for 3.50–3.74. You must study full time (30 ECTS/semester). Athletic scholarships up to 40% also exist. International students from Georgia, Qatar and elsewhere are eligible.

en: First-year merit reduction from school grades
Up to 50% later for top GPA
English-taught degrees in an EU country

eligibility.en: Full-time undergraduate students who submit their High School Leaving Certificate on application; later awards need a 3.50+ cumulative GPA.

en: Apply to a UNIC bachelor's programme with your school-leaving certificate.
Register full time (30 ECTS per semester).
Your first-year merit percentage is applied to tuition; keep a 3.5+ GPA for later awards.

costs.en: First-year percentage tuition reduction (grade-based); 10%, 20% or 50% per semester afterwards depending on GPA.

score_reason: Accessible merit discounts; amounts not published upfront.

name.en: John Cabot University Global Explorer Full-Tuition Scholarship (Fall 2027)
name.ka: ჯონ კაბოტის უნივერსიტეტის Global Explorer სრული სტიპენდია (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: منحة Global Explorer الكاملة للرسوم في جامعة جون كابوت (خريف 2027)

duration.en: Full length of the bachelor's degree

deadline_note: Awarded for Fall entry only; submit the Merit-Based Scholarship Application with your admission application. JCU uses rolling admission — apply early in the 2026-27 cycle.

summary.en: John Cabot University, an American university in Rome, gives up to three incoming Fall students a full-tuition Global Explorer Scholarship for outstanding academics, leadership and commitment to positive impact.
summary.ka: ჯონ კაბოტის უნივერსიტეტი, ამერიკული უნივერსიტეტი რომში, შემოდგომის მაქსიმუმ სამ ახალ სტუდენტს სრულ Global Explorer სტიპენდიას აძლევს გამორჩეული აკადემიური მოსწრების, ლიდერობისა და საზოგადოებრივი წვლილისთვის.
summary.ar: تمنح جامعة جون كابوت، وهي جامعة أمريكية في روما، ما يصل إلى ثلاثة طلاب جدد في الخريف منحة Global Explorer الكاملة للرسوم تقديراً للتفوق الأكاديمي والقيادة والالتزام بإحداث أثر إيجابي.

about.en:
John Cabot University (JCU) is an English-language, US-accredited liberal arts university in Rome's Trastevere district. It awards about $8 million a year, and 85% of students receive a JCU scholarship or grant.

The Global Explorer Scholarship is its most competitive award: full tuition for up to three students in each incoming Fall class, recognising outstanding academic achievement, leadership potential and commitment to making a positive impact. You apply through JCU's single Merit-Based Scholarship Application; the committee awards each applicant the highest-value merit scholarship they qualify for. Housing and personal costs are not covered. Open to all nationalities.

en: Full tuition, up to 3 per year
One application for all merit awards
US-accredited degree in Rome

eligibility.en: Incoming first-year Fall students of any nationality with outstanding academics, leadership and community impact.

en: Apply for undergraduate admission to JCU for Fall 2027.
Complete the Merit-Based Scholarship Application (online form).
Include strong essays, recommendations and evidence of leadership.
You are notified of any award with your acceptance.

costs.en: Full tuition (Fall and Spring semesters). Does not cover housing, travel, books or personal costs.

score_reason: Rare full-tuition award but only three places.

name.ar: المنحة الرئاسية في جامعة جون كابوت (البكالوريوس)

deadline_note: Rolling: submit the Merit-Based Scholarship Application with your admission application; decisions come with acceptance.

summary.en: JCU's Presidential Scholarship gives incoming undergraduates up to $9,500 (€7,000) a year for outstanding academic achievement, renewable with a 2.67 GPA.
summary.ka: JCU-ს საპრეზიდენტო სტიპენდია ახალ ბაკალავრებს გამორჩეული აკადემიური მიღწევისთვის წელიწადში $9,500-მდე (€7,000) აძლევს, 2.67 GPA-ით განახლებადი.
summary.ar: تمنح المنحة الرئاسية في جامعة جون كابوت طلاب البكالوريوس الجدد حتى 9,500 دولار (7,000 يورو) سنوياً للتفوق الأكاديمي، وتتجدد بمعدل 2.67.

about.en:
The Presidential Scholarship is a prestigious partial-tuition award that John Cabot University gives on acceptance for outstanding academic achievement. Recipients receive up to $9,500 (€7,000) per academic year, renewable each year if they keep a cumulative GPA of 2.67 and make academic progress.

It is one of several merit awards (others target specific regions, e.g. the Expansion Scholarship for Latin America and Africa) assessed through one Merit-Based Scholarship Application, and can be combined with need-based aid. Open to all nationalities.

en: Up to €7,000 per year
Renewable with a 2.67 GPA
Combinable with need-based aid

eligibility.en: Incoming first-year undergraduates with outstanding academic records; any nationality.

en: Apply for undergraduate admission to JCU.
Submit the Merit-Based Scholarship Application.
Receive your award with your acceptance letter.

costs.en: Up to $9,500 (€7,000) per academic year toward tuition.

score_reason: Renewable merit award open to all; 85% of JCU students get aid.

name.en: University College Roosevelt Scholarships (Regional, Academic Excellence and Science)
name.ka: University College Roosevelt-ის სტიპენდიები (რეგიონული, აკადემიური ექსელენსი, მეცნიერება)
name.ar: منح كلية روزفلت الجامعية (الإقليمية والتميز الأكاديمي والعلوم)

deadline_note: Annual scholarship round for incoming students; check the UCR financial support page for the 2027 application dates.

summary.en: UCR, Utrecht University's honours liberal arts college in Middelburg, offers need-based scholarships of €10,000 (non-European fee payers) over three years, including regional awards for the Middle East and Africa, Asia and the Americas.
summary.ka: UCR, უტრეხტის უნივერსიტეტის საპატიო ლიბერალური ხელოვნების კოლეჯი მიდელბურგში, საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებულ სტიპენდიებს გასცემს — არაევროპული საფასურის გადამხდელებისთვის €10,000 სამ წელიწადში — მათ შორის რეგიონულს ახლო აღმოსავლეთისა და აფრიკისთვის, აზიისა და ამერიკისთვის.
summary.ar: تقدم كلية روزفلت الجامعية، كلية الفنون الليبرالية للتميز التابعة لجامعة أوتريخت في ميدلبورخ، منحاً حسب الحاجة بقيمة 10,000 يورو (لدافعي الرسوم غير الأوروبية) على ثلاث سنوات، منها منح إقليمية للشرق الأوسط وأفريقيا وآسيا والأمريكتين.

about.en:
University College Roosevelt is a small, residential, English-taught liberal arts and sciences college of Utrecht University. All UCR scholarships are need-based: you qualify only if your parents' combined net income is below €40,000 a year.

Regional Scholarships go to nationals who completed their last two school years in the region (one each for Europe, Australia & Asia, Central & South America, North America, and the Middle East & Africa, plus three for the Netherlands). Non-European regional awards are €10,000 paid over three years; there are also Academic Excellence Scholarships for top-10% students in need, a scholarship for a student affected by war, and Andrew Brooks Entrance Scholarships in Science. Students from Georgia and Qatar can apply under the relevant region.

en: €10,000 for non-European students (over 3 years)
Regional awards incl. Middle East & Africa
Honours college of Utrecht University

eligibility.en: Incoming UCR students whose parents' combined net annual income is below €40,000; regional awards require nationality and the last two school years in that region.

en: Apply for admission to UCR's Liberal Arts and Sciences bachelor's.
Submit the UCR scholarship application with proof of parental income.
Indicate the regional, war-affected or science scholarship you qualify for.

costs.en: €5,000 (European fee) or €10,000 (non-European fee) paid in equal parts over years 1–3; non-EU tuition about €12,651 in 2027-28.

score_reason: Real but limited need-based awards at an honours college.

name.ar: منحة كلية إيراسموس الجامعية (EUC)

duration.en: Full length of the bachelor's degree

deadline_note: Annual round for incoming students; dates are announced on the EUC financial support page during the 2027 admissions cycle.

summary.en: Erasmus University College in Rotterdam offers the EUC Scholarship to highly qualified students from any country who can prove they need financial aid to study its liberal arts and sciences bachelor's.
summary.ka: როტერდამის Erasmus University College ნებისმიერი ქვეყნის მაღალკვალიფიციურ სტუდენტებს, რომლებიც ფინანსური დახმარების საჭიროებას დაამტკიცებენ, ლიბერალური ხელოვნებისა და მეცნიერებების ბაკალავრიატისთვის EUC სტიპენდიას სთავაზობს.
summary.ar: تقدم كلية إيراسموس الجامعية في روتردام منحة EUC للطلاب المؤهلين تأهيلاً عالياً من أي دولة ممن يثبتون حاجتهم إلى مساعدة مالية لدراسة بكالوريوس الفنون الليبرالية والعلوم.

about.en:
Erasmus University College (EUC) is the English-taught liberal arts and sciences honours college of Erasmus University Rotterdam, located in the city centre. Its own EUC Scholarship is meant for highly qualified students from any country who can prove they need financial aid to be able to study at EUC.

Non-EEA students can also combine it with the NL Scholarship and Erasmus University's other financial aid. Applicants from Georgia, Qatar and anywhere else are eligible.

en: For any nationality
Merit + demonstrated need
Honours college in central Rotterdam

eligibility.en: Highly qualified incoming EUC students of any nationality who can demonstrate financial need.

en: Apply for admission to the EUC Liberal Arts and Sciences bachelor's.
Submit the EUC Scholarship application with evidence of financial need during the scholarship round.
Also check the NL Scholarship and EUR aid options for non-EEA students.

costs.en: Partial tuition support; amount depends on need.

score_reason: Open to all nationalities; amount not published.

name.ar: منح صندوق كلية أمستردام الجامعية (ASF)

duration.en: Full length of the bachelor's degree

deadline_note: Applications for new ASF Scholarships are scheduled to reopen in January 2027; eligibility and deadlines will be published then.

summary.en: The AUC Scholarship Fund supports students of Amsterdam University College, the joint liberal arts college of the University of Amsterdam and VU Amsterdam. The next round of ASF Scholarships opens in January 2027.
summary.ka: AUC-ის სტიპენდიების ფონდი ამსტერდამის უნივერსიტეტისა და VU Amsterdam-ის ერთობლივი ლიბერალური ხელოვნების კოლეჯის სტუდენტებს უჭერს მხარს. ASF სტიპენდიების შემდეგი რაუნდი 2027 წლის იანვარში იხსნება.
summary.ar: يدعم صندوق منح كلية أمستردام الجامعية طلاب الكلية المشتركة للفنون الليبرالية بين جامعة أمستردام وجامعة VU أمستردام، وتفتح الجولة القادمة من منح ASF في يناير 2027.

about.en:
Amsterdam University College (AUC) is the English-taught liberal arts and sciences bachelor's college run jointly by the University of Amsterdam and Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam. Its AUC Scholarship Fund (ASF) offers ASF Scholarships (need-based) and Talent Fellowships to AUC students.

All 2025-26 funding has been awarded; applications are scheduled to reopen in January 2027 with updated criteria. ASF Scholarships are only awarded to AUC students, so apply to AUC first. Non-EEA applicants can also look at the NL Scholarship.

en: Need-based scholarships + Talent Fellowships
New round opens January 2027
Joint UvA–VU honours college

eligibility.en: Admitted or current AUC students; detailed criteria for new ASF Scholarships will be published when applications reopen in January 2027.

en: Apply for admission to AUC's Liberal Arts and Sciences bachelor's.
Watch the ASF page for the January 2027 opening.
Submit the ASF application form with the requested financial information.

costs.en: Partial tuition/living support; amounts published with the 2027 round.

score_reason: Opening soon; details pending.
